<script>/* Static, locally bundled copy. No text is sent to a translation service. */
(function(root){
  "use strict";
  const dictionary=root.LiftMyanmar||{};
  const localeKey="lift-language-v1";
  let locale="en";
  try{locale=localStorage.getItem(localeKey)==="my"?"my":"en";}catch{}
  const keys=Object.keys(dictionary).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length);
  function translate(source,params){
    let value=String(source);
    if(locale==="my"){
      if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(dictionary,value))value=dictionary[value];
      else {
        // Composite text nodes (for example a note followed by its saving status)
        // are translated from exact reviewed phrases, never from user content.
        let rest=value,result="";
        while(rest){
          let best=null,pos=rest.length;
          for(const key of keys){const i=rest.indexOf(key);if(i>=0&&(i<pos||(i===pos&&key.length>(best||"").length))){
            const before=rest[i-1],after=rest[i+key.length];
            if((!before||!/[A-Za-z]/.test(before))&&(!after||!/[A-Za-z]/.test(after))){best=key;pos=i;}
          }}
          if(!best){result+=rest;break;}
          result+=rest.slice(0,pos)+dictionary[best];rest=rest.slice(pos+best.length);
        }
        value=result;
      }
    }
    return value.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g,(match,key)=>params&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params,key)?String(params[key]):match);
  }
  const textSources=new WeakMap(),attributeSources=new WeakMap();
  let observer;
  function render(){
    if(!root.document)return;
    if(observer)observer.disconnect();
    document.documentElement.lang=locale;
    const walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    let node;
    while((node=walker.nextNode())){
      if(node.parentElement.closest('script,style,textarea,[data-user-content],[data-language-name]'))continue;
      const previous=textSources.get(node),current=node.nodeValue;
      const source=previous&&current===previous.rendered?previous.source:current;
      const trimmed=source.trim();
      const translated=translate(trimmed);
      const rendered=trimmed?source.replace(trimmed,translated):source;
      if(current!==rendered)node.nodeValue=rendered;
      textSources.set(node,{source,rendered});
    }
    for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label],[placeholder]')){
      if(el.closest('[data-user-content],[data-language-name]'))continue;
      const saved=attributeSources.get(el)||{};
      for(const attr of ['aria-label','placeholder'])if(el.hasAttribute(attr)){
        const current=el.getAttribute(attr),last=saved[attr],source=last&&current===last.rendered?last.source:current;
        const rendered=translate(source);if(current!==rendered)el.setAttribute(attr,rendered);saved[attr]={source,rendered};
      }
      attributeSources.set(el,saved);
    }
    const label=document.getElementById('current-language');
    if(label)label.textContent=locale==="my"?"မြန်မာ":"English";
    if(observer)observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['aria-label','placeholder']});
  }
  function setLocale(value){locale=value==="my"?"my":"en";try{localStorage.setItem(localeKey,locale);}catch{}render();}
  const api={t:translate,render,setLocale,get locale(){return locale;}};
  if(typeof module!=="undefined"&&module.exports)module.exports=api;
  else root.LiftI18n=api;
  if(root.document){observer=new MutationObserver(render);render();}
})(typeof window!=="undefined"?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>(function(root){
'use strict';
const processes=['unknown','report','stay','work','other'],sources=['receipt','notice','message'];
function validDate(value){if(typeof value!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value))return false;const year=Number(value.slice(0,4));if(year<1900||year>2200)return false;const date=new Date(value+'T00:00:00Z');return Number.isFinite(+date)&&date.toISOString().slice(0,10)===value;}
function normalize(values){const seen=new Set();return (Array.isArray(values)?values:[]).slice(0,6).flatMap(v=>{if(!v||typeof v!=='object'||!validDate(v.date)||typeof v.id!=='string'||! /^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{8,64}$/.test(v.id)||seen.has(v.id))return [];seen.add(v.id);return [{id:v.id,date:v.date,process:processes.includes(v.process)?v.process:'unknown',source:sources.includes(v.source)?v.source:'message',revision:Number.isInteger(v.revision)?Math.max(0,Math.min(9999,v.revision)):0}];});}
function keep(values,input){const list=normalize(values);if(input?.confirmed!==true||!validDate(input.date)||!processes.includes(input.process)||!sources.includes(input.source))throw Error('invalid');const existing=list.find(x=>x.id===input.id);if(!existing&&list.length>=6)throw Error('full');const record=normalize([{...input,revision:existing?existing.revision+1:0}])[0];if(!record)throw Error('invalid');return existing?list.map(x=>x.id===record.id?record:x):[...list,record];}
function escapeCalendar(s){return String(s).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/\r\n|\r|\n/g,'\\n').replace(/;/g,'\\;').replace(/,/g,'\\,');}
function fold(line){let out='',current='',bytes=0;for(const char of line){const size=new TextEncoder().encode(char).length;if(bytes+size>75){out+=current+'\r\n';current=' ';bytes=1;}current+=char;bytes+=size;}return out+current;}
function calendar(value,title,description,now=new Date()){
 const record=normalize([value])[0];if(!record||!Number.isFinite(+now))throw Error('invalid');const next=new Date(record.date+'T00:00:00Z');next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate()+1);
 return ['BEGIN:VCALENDAR','VERSION:2.0','PRODID:-//Lift//Personal reminder//EN','CALSCALE:GREGORIAN','BEGIN:VEVENT','UID:'+record.id+'@lift-next-step.vercel.app','DTSTAMP:'+now.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g,'').replace(/\.\d{3}/,''),'SEQUENCE:'+record.revision,'DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:'+record.date.replace(/-/g,''),'DTEND;VALUE=DATE:'+next.toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,''),'SUMMARY:'+escapeCalendar(title),'DESCRIPTION:'+escapeCalendar(description),'TRANSP:TRANSPARENT','END:VEVENT','END:VCALENDAR'].map(fold).join('\r\n')+'\r\n';
}
const api={normalize,validDate,keep,calendar};if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.LiftDates=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>(function(root){'use strict';
const topics=['start','language','routine','device','cost','support'];
function normalize(value){const selected=Array.isArray(value?.topics)?[...new Set(value.topics.filter(x=>topics.includes(x)))]:['start'];return {topics:selected,ready:Array.isArray(value?.ready)?[...new Set(value.ready.filter(x=>selected.includes(x)))]:[]};}
function toggleTopic(value,key,checked){const state=normalize(value);if(!topics.includes(key))return state;return normalize({...state,topics:checked?[...state.topics,key]:state.topics.filter(x=>x!==key)});}
function toggleReady(value,key,checked){const state=normalize(value);if(!state.topics.includes(key))return state;return normalize({...state,ready:checked?[...state.ready,key]:state.ready.filter(x=>x!==key)});}
function questionKeys(value){return normalize(value).topics.map(key=>key+'Q');}
const api={topics,normalize,toggleTopic,toggleReady,questionKeys};if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.LiftFamily=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  const dates = root.LiftDates || (typeof require === 'function' ? require('./dates.js') : null);
  const family = root.LiftFamily || (typeof require === 'function' ? require('./family.js') : null);
  const planKeys = ['work', 'skills', 'support', 'stability', 'assets'];
  const text = (value, limit) => typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().slice(0, limit) : '';
  const indices = (values, limit) => Array.isArray(values) ? [...new Set(values.filter(n => Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n < limit))] : [];
  function empty() { return {family:{topics:['start'],ready:[]},dates:[],version:2,plan:null,checked:[],remember:false,goal:'',history:[],edits:{},custom:[],prep:[]}; }
  function normalize(value) {
    const result = empty();
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return result;
    result.remember = value.remember === true;
    result.dates = dates.normalize(value.dates);
    result.family = family.normalize(value.family);
    result.plan = planKeys.includes(value.plan) ? value.plan : null;
    result.prep = indices(value.prep,6);
    result.history = Array.isArray(value.history) ? value.history.slice(0,20).filter(x => x && planKeys.includes(x.plan) && typeof x.changedAt === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(x.changedAt) && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(x.changedAt))).map(x => ({goal:text(x.goal,100),plan:x.plan,changedAt:new Date(x.changedAt).toISOString(),done:Math.max(0,Math.min(10,Number.isInteger(x.done)?x.done:0)),total:Math.max(4,Math.min(10,Number.isInteger(x.total)?x.total:4))})).map(x=>({...x,done:Math.min(x.done,x.total)})) : [];
    if (!result.plan) return result;
    result.goal = text(value.goal,100);
    result.custom = Array.isArray(value.custom) ? value.custom.slice(0,6).filter(x => x && typeof x === 'object' && text(x.title,120)).map(x => ({title:text(x.title,120),detail:text(x.detail,240)})) : [];
    result.checked = indices(value.checked,4+result.custom.length);
    if (value.edits && typeof value.edits === 'object') for (let i=0;i<4;i++) {
      const edit = value.edits[i];
      if(edit && typeof edit === 'object' && text(edit.title,120)) result.edits[i] = {title:text(edit.title,120),detail:text(edit.detail,240)};
    }
    return result;
  }
  function tasks(state,defaults) {
    return defaults.map(([title,detail],i) => state.edits[i] || {title,detail}).concat(state.custom);
  }
  function archiveGoal(state,now=new Date().toISOString()) {
    if(!state.plan||(!state.goal&&!state.checked.length))return [...(state.history||[])];
    return [{goal:state.goal,plan:state.plan,changedAt:now,done:state.checked.length,total:4+state.custom.length},...(state.history||[])].slice(0,20);
  }
  function setGoal(state,value) {
    const goal=text(value,100);
    if(goal===state.goal)return state;
    return {...state,goal,history:archiveGoal(state)};
  }
  function changePlan(state,key) {
    if (!planKeys.includes(key) || state.plan===key) return state;
    return {...empty(),dates:dates.normalize(state.dates),family:family.normalize(state.family),plan:key,remember:state.remember,prep:[...state.prep],history:archiveGoal(state)};
  }
  function removeCustom(state,index) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(index) || index<4 || index>=4+state.custom.length) return state;
    return {...state,custom:state.custom.filter((_,i)=>i!==index-4),checked:state.checked.filter(i=>i!==index).map(i=>i>index?i-1:i)};
  }
  const api = {empty,normalize,tasks,changePlan,setGoal,archiveGoal,removeCustom,indices,text};
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = api;
  else root.LiftPlanner = api;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
</script>
<script>(function(root){
'use strict';
const fields=['available','food','home','travel','phone','other'];
function parse(value){
 if(typeof value!=='string')throw Error('invalid');
 const text=value.trim().replace(/[၀-၉]/g,c=>String(c.charCodeAt(0)-0x1040));
 if(!text)return null;
 if(!/^(?:\d+|\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(text))throw Error('invalid');
 const parts=text.replace(/,/g,'').split('.');const cents=Number(parts[0])*100+Number((parts[1]||'').padEnd(2,'0'));
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(cents)||cents>999999999)throw Error('invalid');return cents;
}
function calculate(input){
 const amounts={};let entered=false;
 for(const name of fields){const amount=parse(input[name]??'');amounts[name]=amount??0;if(amount!==null)entered=true;}
 if(!entered)throw Error('empty');
 const costs=fields.slice(1).reduce((sum,key)=>sum+amounts[key],0);
 return {available:amounts.available,costs,remaining:amounts.available-costs};
}
const api={fields,parse,calculate};if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.LiftSpending=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>

function icon(name) { return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${icons[name] || icons.sprout}</svg>`; }
function paintIcons() { document.querySelectorAll('[data-icon]').forEach(el => { el.innerHTML = icon(el.dataset.icon); }); }
function escapeText(value) { return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char])); }

const STORAGE_KEY = 'lift-plan-v1';
let state = LiftPlanner.empty();
let resourceFilter = 'all';
let searchTerm = '';
let toastTimer;
try { const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||'null'); if(saved?.remember===true) state=LiftPlanner.normalize(saved); } catch { /* Continue without storage. */ }
const main = document.getElementById('main');
const dialog = document.getElementById('dialog');
const dialogContent = document.getElementById('dialog-content');
let dialogReturnFocus = null;
function toast(message) { const el=document.getElementById('toast'); el.textContent=LiftI18n.t(message); el.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),4000); }
function persist() { try { if(state.remember) localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(state)); else localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); return true; } catch { state.remember=false; toast('This browser cannot save your plan. You can still use it in this tab.'); return false; } }
function openDialog(html) { dialogReturnFocus=document.activeElement; dialogContent.innerHTML=html; paintIcons(); LiftI18n.render(); if(!dialog.open) dialog.showModal(); }
function closeDialog() { dialog.close(); if(dialogReturnFocus?.isConnected) dialogReturnFocus.focus(); }
document.getElementById('dialog-close').addEventListener('click',closeDialog);
dialog.addEventListener('click',event=>{ if(event.target===dialog){const r=dialog.getBoundingClientRect();if(event.clientX<r.left||event.clientX>r.right||event.clientY<r.top||event.clientY>r.bottom)closeDialog();} });
dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{if(dialogReturnFocus?.isConnected)dialogReturnFocus.focus();});

function landscape(){return `<div class="landscape" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 260 330" preserveAspectRatio="xMaxYMax slice"><circle cx="208" cy="107" r="53" fill="#e6ba94"/><path d="M130 330V195c0-60 30-86 66-86s66 26 66 86v135" fill="#d3dcc2"/><path d="M153 330V199c0-42 20-63 43-63s43 21 43 63v131" fill="#e8ecdf"/><path d="M0 310c70-95 151-69 260-134v154H0Z" fill="#c2cfae"/><path d="M0 330c91-45 145-5 260-69v69Z" fill="#a4b58d"/><path d="M77 330c18-57 66-74 103-107" stroke="#f2eee0" stroke-width="20" fill="none"/><path d="M210 266v-74m0 34c-26 0-33-18-29-37 24 1 32 16 29 37Zm1-12c20 0 28-16 25-31-21 1-28 14-25 31Z" stroke="#6d855b" stroke-width="2" fill="#839b6d"/></svg></div>`;}
function totalTasks(){return state.plan?4+state.custom.length:0;}
function progress(){return state.plan ? state.checked.length : 0;}
function planSidebar(){if(!state.plan)return `<section class="plan-card"><div class="card-kicker">A little direction</div><h2>Your next step<br>can start here.</h2><p>You don’t need to have everything figured out. Choose one thing that would help today.</p><div class="plan-illustration">${icon('sprout')}</div><button class="secondary" data-action="choose">Make a small plan <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button><div class="small-assurance">${icon('lock')}No account or personal details needed</div></section>`;const p=plans[state.plan];return `<section class="plan-card"><div class="card-kicker">Your small plan</div><h2>${p.title}</h2><p>${p.description}</p><div class="plan-progress-label"><span>Your own progress</span><span>${LiftI18n.t('{done} of {total} steps',{done:progress(),total:totalTasks()})}</span></div><div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${totalTasks()?progress()/totalTasks()*100:0}%"></div></div><a class="primary" style="display:flex;margin-top:20px" href="#steps">Continue my plan ${icon('arrow')}</a><div class="small-assurance">${icon('lock')}${state.remember?'Saved on this browser by your choice':'Kept in this tab until you leave'}</div></section>`;}
function sideNote(){return `<section class="side-note"><div class="note-icon">${icon('heart')}</div><h3>You set the pace.</h3><p>You can ask questions, change your plan, or take a break. Your choices belong to you.</p><a href="#privacy">How your information stays yours</a></section><p class="private-note">${icon('shield')}<span>This is an early prototype. Information links are independent; a support organisation has not yet joined Lift.</span></p>`;}

You can return to any stage.</p></div><aside class="side-column" aria-label="Your plan and choices">${planSidebar()}${sideNote()}</aside></div><section class="content-card" style="margin:20px 0"><div class="eyebrow">Clear Job Cards</div><h2>Read a job poster honestly</h2><p>Photo in → structured card out. Missing pay or fees stay NOT STATED. Fee language is flagged before you share. No account. No tracking.</p><a class="secondary" href="./job-card.html">Try Clear Job Cards</a></section><div class="trust-strip"><span>${icon('check')}Free to explore</span><span>${icon('shield')}You control what you share</span><span>${icon('people')}Human support matters</span></div>`;}
function heading(kicker,title,desc){return `<div class="page-heading"><div class="eyebrow">${kicker}</div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${desc}</p></div>`;}
function steps(){let body;if(!state.plan)body=`<section class="content-card empty-state"><span class="mini-icon">${icon('sprout')}</span><h2>A small plan is enough to begin.</h2><p>Choose what would help today. We’ll suggest four practical steps you can adapt to your own situation.</p><button class="primary" data-action="choose">Make my first plan ${icon('arrow')}</button></section>`;else {const p=plans[state.plan];body=`<section class="content-card"><div class="plan-title-row"><div><div class="card-kicker">A plan you control</div><h2>${p.title}</h2></div><span class="mini-icon">${icon(p.icon)}</span></div><p style="margin-top:13px">${p.description}</p><div class="plan-progress-label"><span>Steps you have marked complete</span><span>${progress()} of 4</span></div><div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${totalTasks()?progress()/totalTasks()*100:0}%"></div></div><ul class="checklist">${p.tasks.map(([title,desc],i)=>`<li class="${state.checked.includes(i)?'done':''}"><label><input type="checkbox" data-task="${i}" ${state.checked.includes(i)?'checked':''}><span><strong>${title}</strong><small>${desc}</small></span></label></li>`).join('')}</ul>${progress()===4?'<div class="completion-note" role="status"><strong>You’ve worked through your plan.</strong><p>Take a moment to recognise that effort. You can revisit a step or choose a new plan whenever you want.</p></div>':''}<div class="plan-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="export">Review my plan ${icon('download')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="choose">Choose another plan</button></div><p class="inline-notice">These checkmarks reflect your own progress. They do not confirm an application, a job, funding or a response from an organisation.</p></section>`;}
return `${heading('One thing at a time','My next steps','A plan to help you move forward, with space to change your mind.')}<div class="page-grid"><div>${body}<section class="content-card"><h2>Keep your choices open.</h2><p>Read about an opportunity before committing. Ask what it involves, what it costs and what information is necessary. You can pause whenever you need to.</p><a class="text-button" href="#resources">Explore useful information</a></section></div><aside class="side-column"><section class="side-note"><div class="note-icon">${icon('lock')}</div><h3>Your plan, your choice.</h3><p>${state.remember?'You chose to save your plan in this browser. Anyone using this browser may see it.':'Your plan stays in this tab by default. Closing or reloading the page clears it unless you choose to save.'}</p><a href="#privacy">Manage saving and privacy</a></section><p class="private-note">${icon('heart')}<span>Completing a plan is optional. Support should never depend on keeping a perfect streak.</span></p></aside></div>`;}
function resourceCards(){const query=searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();const found=resources.filter(r=>(resourceFilter==='all'||r.category===resourceFilter)&&(!query||`${r.title} ${r.description} ${r.label} ${LiftI18n.t(r.description)} ${LiftI18n.t(r.label)}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)));return found.length?found.map(r=>`<article class="resource-card"><div class="resource-card-heading"><span class="resource-symbol">${icon(r.category==='work'?'work':r.category==='skills'?'learn':'people')}</span><div class="resource-tag">${r.label}</div>${r.url?`<span class="resource-exit" aria-hidden="true">${icon('globe')}</span>`:''}</div><h2>${r.title}</h2><p>${r.description}</p>${r.checked?`<small>${r.independent}</small><details class="resource-source-details"><summary>${r.checked}</summary><p>${r.note}</p></details>`:`<small>${r.note}</small>`}${r.url?`<a href="${r.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${r.visitLabel||`Visit ${r.title}`} <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>`:`<button class="text-button" data-action="choose" data-plan="${r.action}">Make a conversation plan <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>`}</article>`).join(''):'<section class="content-card"><h2>No matching information here yet.</h2><p>Try a different word or choose All topics. This is a small starting collection, not a complete service directory.</p></section>';}
function resourcePage(){return `${heading('A place to explore','Useful information','Independent sources and a simple planning tool. Check current services, languages and availability directly with each source.')}<section class="content-card" style="margin-bottom:16px"><div class="eyebrow">New for Meta hackathon demo</div><h2>Clear Job Cards</h2><p>Turn a job poster into an honest card. Every field quotes the poster or is NOT STATED. Fee and deposit language is flagged before you share a copy. Runs on this device — no account, no GPS.</p><a class="primary" href="./job-card.html">Open Clear Job Cards</a></section><label for="resource-search" class="search-label">Search this collection</label><input class="search-input" id="resource-search" type="search" placeholder="Try work, learning or support" value="${escapeText(searchTerm)}"><div class="filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter information by topic">${[['all','All topics'],['work','Work'],['skills','Learning'],['support','Support']].map(([key,label])=>`<button class="filter-button ${resourceFilter===key?'active':''}" data-filter="${key}" aria-pressed="${resourceFilter===key}">${label}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="muted-label" id="resource-count" aria-live="polite"></p><div id="resource-list" class="resource-grid" style="margin-top:12px">${resourceCards()}</div><p class="inline-notice">Lift has not arranged assistance with these organisations. Opening an external website is your choice and its own privacy terms apply.</p>`;}
function privacy(){return `${heading('You stay in control','Your information belongs to you.','A little help should never mean giving up your privacy. This prototype asks for no account, identity documents or financial details.')}<div class="page-grid"><div><section class="content-card"><div class="privacy-row"><div><h3>Remember my plan on this browser</h3><p>Only turn this on if you are comfortable with other people using this browser being able to see your plan.</p></div><label><input type="checkbox" id="remember-plan" aria-label="Remember my plan on this browser" ${state.remember?'checked':''}><span>${state.remember?'On':'Off'}</span></label></div><p class="inline-notice">${state.remember?'Saving is on. Your plan, edited steps and preparation checklist are stored on this browser.':'Saving is off. Your plan and checkmarks stay in this tab until you close or reload it.'}</p></section><section class="content-card"><h2>Clear your plan</h2><p>Remove your plan, edited steps and preparation checklist from this tab and this browser. Any copy you downloaded remains in your files.</p><button class="danger-button" style="margin-top:17px" data-action="clear">Clear my Lift plan</button></section><section class="content-card"><h2>A few plain answers</h2><details><summary>Does Lift share my plan with anyone?</summary><p>This prototype does not upload or send your plan. You can review and download a copy yourself. When you visit another website, that website receives the request and its own privacy terms apply.</p></details><details><summary>What happens on a shared phone?</summary><p>Leave saving off. If you have enabled it, turn it off or clear your plan before someone else uses the browser. Downloaded copies remain in the phone’s files.</p></details><details><summary>Does Lift make decisions about my eligibility?</summary><p>No. This prototype provides a planning checklist. A programme or service provider must explain its own requirements and make its own decisions with an appropriate review process.</p></details><details><summary>Are translation or AI services running here?</summary><p>This planner uses bundled English and Myanmar wording. The separate information checker sends only the message or image you choose, after consent, to Meta models through Vercel AI Gateway. Read its privacy notice before checking. It needs an internet connection.</p></details></section></div><aside class="side-column"><section class="plan-card"><div class="card-kicker">Our commitment</div><h2>Support with dignity.</h2><ul class="privacy-list"><li>${icon('shield')}<span><strong>No employer surveillance</strong>Your personal plan is not an employer dashboard.</span></li><li>${icon('heart')}<span><strong>No pressure to participate</strong>You choose your next step and your pace.</span></li><li>${icon('lock')}<span><strong>No personal data on a blockchain</strong>This prototype does not move money or connect a wallet.</span></li></ul></section></aside></div>`;}
function receiptPage(){const copy=LiftCommunityIntakeCopy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'];return heading('You stay in control',copy.check,'')+'<section class="content-card" id="community-intake-slot" data-user-content></section>';}
function route(){const name=location.hash.slice(1)||'home';const key=['home','steps','resources','prepare','privacy','family','dates','language','about','spending','daily','community','life','mine','receipts'].includes(name)?name:'home';document.body.dataset.route=key;main.innerHTML=({home,steps,life:()=>lifePage(),mine:()=>minePage(),receipts:()=>receiptPage(),community:()=>typeof communityPage==='function'?communityPage():'',daily:()=>typeof everydayPage==='function'?everydayPage():'',spending:()=>typeof spendingPage==='function'?spendingPage():'',dates:()=>datesPage(),language:()=>languagePage(),about:()=>aboutPage(),resources:resourcePage,prepare:()=>typeof preparationPage==='function'?preparationPage():'',privacy,family:()=>typeof familyPage==='function'?familyPage():''}[key])();document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach(el=>{const active=el.dataset.route===key;el.classList.toggle('active',active);if(active)el.setAttribute('aria-current','page');else el.removeAttribute('aria-current');});document.getElementById('nav-count').textContent=state.plan?String(totalTasks()-progress()):'0';paintIcons();LiftI18n.render();document.title=`${LiftI18n.t(({receipts:LiftCommunityIntakeCopy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'].check,life:'Everyday life',mine:'My next steps',home:'Your next step, together',steps:'My next steps',resources:'Useful information',prepare:'Prepare a conversation',privacy:'My privacy',family:'Learning for my family',dates:'My dates and reminders',language:'Thai learning and everyday translation',about:'About this prototype',spending:'Daily spending',daily:'Everyday questions',community:'Community questions and sharing'})[key])} — Lift`;}
function navigate(hash){if(location.hash===hash)route();else location.hash=hash;}
function planPreview(key){return `<div class="plan-preview"><div class="card-kicker">Your small plan</div><p>${plans[key].description}</p><ol>${plans[key].tasks.map(([title,detail])=>`<li><strong>${title}</strong><small>${detail}</small></li>`).join('')}</ol></div>`;}
function choosePlan(preselect){const selected=plans[preselect]?preselect:(state.plan||'support');openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Start with what matters</div><h2 id="dialog-title">What would help you today?</h2><p>You don’t have to share your story to make a plan. Choose a starting point; you can change it later.</p><form id="plan-form"><div class="choice-list">${[['support','Understand my support options','Prepare for a conversation with someone I trust.'],['work','Explore work','Make a practical plan before pursuing an opportunity.'],['skills','Explore learning','Choose a skill and a manageable first step.'],['stability','Understand my earnings','Take stock and identify a question to resolve.'],['assets','Think about a future goal','Make a little space for a goal that matters to me.']].map(([key,title,desc])=>`<label class="choice-label"><input type="radio" name="plan" value="${key}" ${selected===key?'checked':''} required><span><strong>${title}</strong><small>${desc}</small></span></label>`).join('')}</div><div id="plan-preview">${planPreview(selected)}</div>${state.plan?'<p class="dialog-note">Choosing a different plan replaces your current checklist. You can download your current plan first from My next steps.</p><button type="button" class="text-button" data-action="goal-history">Review your earlier goals before choosing a different plan.</button>':''}<div class="dialog-actions"><button type="submit" class="primary">${state.plan?'Use this plan':'Make my plan'} ${icon('arrow')}</button><button type="button" class="secondary" data-action="close">Maybe later</button></div><p class="dialog-note">No account needed. No personal details requested. Saving on this browser is optional.</p></form>`);}
function exportText(){const p=plans[state.plan];return `MY LIFT PLAN\n${p.title}\n\n${p.tasks.map(([title,desc],i)=>`${state.checked.includes(i)?'[Done]':'[ ]'} ${title}\n${desc}`).join('\n\n')}\n\nPrepared locally in the Lift early prototype.\nThese checkmarks reflect my own progress, not confirmation from a provider.\nI choose whether to share this copy. No personal identity or financial information is included.\n`;}
function showExport(){if(!state.plan)return;openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Review before you share</div><h2 id="dialog-title">This copy belongs to you.</h2><p>Nothing is sent to an organisation. Review the exact contents below. A downloaded copy can be read by anyone who can access your files.</p><pre class="export-preview" data-user-content>${escapeText(exportText())}</pre><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="download">Download my plan ${icon('download')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Keep it here</button></div>`);}
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const filter=event.target.closest('[data-filter]');if(filter){resourceFilter=filter.dataset.filter;route();document.querySelector(`[data-filter="${resourceFilter}"]`)?.focus();return;}const el=event.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;const action=el.dataset.action;if(action==='choose')choosePlan(el.dataset.plan);if(action==='close')closeDialog();if(action==='stage'){const i=Number(el.dataset.stage),s=stages[i];openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">One part of your journey</div><h2 id="dialog-title">${s.title}</h2><p>${s.description}</p><ul class="stage-detail-list">${s.points.map(p=>`<li>${p}</li>`).join('')}</ul><p>You can begin here or return whenever it feels useful. There are no levels to unlock.</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="choose" data-plan="${s.plan}">Explore a small plan ${icon('arrow')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Close</button></div>`);}if(action==='about')openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Built around people</div><h2 id="dialog-title">A first step for Lift.</h2><p>Lift’s ambition is to support Myanmar migrants in Thailand through access, livelihoods, steadier earnings and long-term goals.</p><p>This early version includes a personal planner, research survey and an experimental AI information checker. Support partnerships, applications and payments are not connected.</p><p>Real service availability, native-language wording and accessibility with participants need validation before a supervised pilot. You can use this prototype without entering personal information.</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="close">Back to Lift</button></div>`);if(action==='export')showExport();if(action==='download'&&state.plan){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([exportText()],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='my-lift-plan.txt';document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);toast('Your plan copy has been downloaded.');closeDialog();}if(action==='clear')openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Your choice</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Clear your Lift plan?</h2><p>This removes your plan, edited steps and preparation checklist from this tab and this browser. Downloaded copies stay in your files.</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="danger-button" data-action="confirm-clear">Yes, clear my plan</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Keep my plan</button></div>`);if(action==='confirm-clear'){state=LiftPlanner.empty();persist();closeDialog();route();toast('Your Lift plan and preparation checklist have been cleared.');}});
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{if(event.target.id!=='plan-form')return;event.preventDefault();const plan=new FormData(event.target).get('plan');if(!plans[plan])return;state=LiftPlanner.changePlan(state,plan);persist();closeDialog();navigate('#steps');main.focus();toast('Your plan is ready. Start with the step that feels manageable.');});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.target.matches('[data-task]')){const task=Number(event.target.dataset.task);state.checked=event.target.checked?[...new Set([...state.checked,task])]:state.checked.filter(i=>i!==task);persist();route();document.querySelector(`[data-task="${task}"]`)?.focus();}if(event.target.id==='remember-plan'){state.remember=event.target.checked;persist();route();document.getElementById('remember-plan')?.focus();toast(state.remember?'Your plan will be remembered on this browser.':'Saving is off. Any saved copy in this browser was removed.');}});
document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(event.target.id==='resource-search'){searchTerm=event.target.value;document.getElementById('resource-list').innerHTML=resourceCards();const count=document.querySelectorAll('.resource-card').length;document.getElementById('resource-count').textContent=`${LiftI18n.t('{count} matching sources',{count})}`;}});
document.getElementById('language-button').addEventListener('click',()=>openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Words that feel familiar</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Language options</h2><p>Choose English or Myanmar. Your own goals and steps stay in the language you wrote them.</p><div class="language-choices"><button class="secondary" data-locale="en" lang="en" data-language-name>English</button><button class="secondary" data-locale="my" lang="my" data-language-name>မြန်မာ</button></div><p class="dialog-note">Language preference is saved on this browser. Your plan has a separate saving choice.</p>`));
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const button=event.target.closest('[data-locale]');if(button){LiftI18n.setLocale(button.dataset.locale);closeDialog();route();LiftI18n.render();}});
document.querySelector('.skip').addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();main.focus();});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{route();main.focus();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});});
route();

document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.target.matches('#plan-form input[name="plan"]')&&plans[event.target.value]){document.getElementById('plan-preview').innerHTML=planPreview(event.target.value);LiftI18n.render();}});
</script>
<script data-offline-copy="true">window.LIFT_DOWNLOADED_COPY=true;

const preparationItems = [

const baseStepsPage=steps;
steps=function(){
  if(!state.plan)return baseStepsPage();
  const plan=plans[state.plan],items=LiftPlanner.tasks(state,plan.tasks),nextIndex=items.findIndex((_,i)=>!state.checked.includes(i)),next=items[nextIndex];
  return `${heading('A plan that fits you','My next steps','Use these suggestions, change their wording or add a step of your own. Your plan is yours to shape.')}<div class="page-grid"><div>${next?`<section class="content-card next-action"><div class="eyebrow">Choose a small first step</div><h2 ${nextIndex>=4||state.edits[nextIndex]?'data-user-content':''}>${escapeText(next.title)}</h2><p ${nextIndex>=4||state.edits[nextIndex]?'data-user-content':''}>${escapeText(next.detail)}</p><div class="plan-actions"><a class="primary" href="#resources">Explore information</a><a class="secondary" href="#prepare">Prepare a conversation</a><button class="text-button" data-action="focus-next" data-index="${nextIndex}">Continue my plan</button></div></section>`:''}<section class="content-card"><div class="plan-title-row"><div><div class="card-kicker">A plan you control</div><h2>${plan.title}</h2></div><span class="mini-icon">${icon(plan.icon)}</span></div><div class="goal-row"><div><span class="field-caption">What I want to work toward</span><p ${state.goal?'data-user-content':''}>${state.goal?escapeText(state.goal):'You can choose a short goal, or leave this open.'}</p></div><button class="text-button" data-action="edit-goal">${state.goal?'Edit goal':'Add a goal'}</button></div><button class="text-button" data-action="goal-history">Review earlier goals</button><div class="plan-progress-label"><span>Steps you have marked complete</span><span>${LiftI18n.t('{done} of {total}',{done:progress(),total:items.length})}</span></div><div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${progress()/items.length*100}%"></div></div><ul class="checklist editable-checklist">${items.map((item,i)=>`<li class="${state.checked.includes(i)?'done':''}"><div class="task-row"><label><input type="checkbox" data-task="${i}" ${state.checked.includes(i)?'checked':''}><span><strong ${i>=4||state.edits[i]?'data-user-content':''}>${escapeText(item.title)}</strong><small ${i>=4||state.edits[i]?'data-user-content':''}>${escapeText(item.detail)}</small></span></label><button class="edit-step" data-action="edit-task" data-index="${i}" aria-label="${escapeText(LiftI18n.t('Edit step {number}',{number:i+1}))}">Edit</button></div></li>`).join('')}</ul>${progress()===items.length?'<div class="completion-note" role="status"><strong>You’ve worked through your plan.</strong><p>You can return to a step, add another or choose a different plan. There is no deadline to keep up with.</p></div>':''}<div class="plan-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="export">Review my plan ${icon('download')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="add-task" ${state.custom.length>=6?'disabled':''}>Add my own step</button><button class="text-button" data-action="choose">Choose another plan</button></div><p class="inline-notice">Checkmarks reflect your own progress. They do not confirm an application, a job, funding or a provider’s response.</p></section><section class="content-card"><h2>A conversation can be a useful step.</h2><p>Prepare what to ask before you choose to contact a service. No document uploads or personal details are required.</p><a class="text-button" href="#prepare">Prepare a conversation</a></section></div><aside class="side-column"><section class="side-note"><div class="note-icon">${icon('lock')}</div><h3>Only what you choose.</h3><p>${state.remember?'Saving is on. Your plan and edits will stay on this browser. Someone using this browser may see them.':'Saving is off. Your edits stay in this tab until you close or reload it.'}</p><a href="#privacy">Manage saving and offline access</a></section><p class="private-note">${icon('heart')}<span>A short plan is enough. There is no need to include your name, document numbers or private circumstances.</span></p></aside></div>`;
};

function preparationPage(){return `${heading('Before you reach out','Prepare a conversation','A small checklist to help you ask questions and make your own choices. This is general preparation, not a service application.')}<div class="page-grid"><div><section class="content-card"><h2>You decide what is ready.</h2><p>These suggestions are optional. You can ask for help even if some items are unfinished.</p><div class="plan-progress-label"><span>Your preparation</span><span>${LiftI18n.t('{done} of {total}',{done:state.prep.length,total:preparationItems.length})}</span></div><div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${state.prep.length/preparationItems.length*100}%"></div></div><ul class="checklist">${preparationItems.map(([title,detail],i)=>`<li class="${state.prep.includes(i)?'done':''}"><label><input type="checkbox" data-prep="${i}" ${state.prep.includes(i)?'checked':''}><span><strong>${title}</strong><small>${detail}</small></span></label></li>`).join('')}</ul><div class="plan-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="review-preparation">Review a copy ${icon('download')}</button><a class="secondary" href="#resources">Explore information</a></div><p class="inline-notice">Checking an item does not send anything or confirm that an organisation can assist. ${state.remember?'Your checklist is saved on this browser.':'Your checklist stays only in this tab while saving is off.'}</p></section><section class="content-card"><h2>What this checklist asks for</h2><p>Only checkmarks. Lift does not ask you to enter your identity, immigration status, employer, bank details or documents here.</p></section></div><aside class="side-column"><section class="side-note"><div class="note-icon">${icon('people')}</div><h3>Ask in your own words.</h3><p>You can ask about language support or have someone you trust help you prepare. You choose whether anyone joins your conversation.</p><a href="#privacy">See your privacy choices</a></section><p class="private-note">${icon('shield')}<span>This checklist is not an emergency service. No one receives or monitors your checkmarks.</span></p></aside></div>`;}

function preparationText(){const t=LiftI18n.t;return `${t('MY LIFT CONVERSATION CHECKLIST')}\n\n${preparationItems.map(([title,detail],i)=>`${state.prep.includes(i)?t('[Ready]'):'[ ]'} ${t(title)}\n${t(detail)}`).join('\n\n')}\n\n${t('This is my own preparation, not an application or confirmation from a provider.\nI choose whether to share it.')}\n`;}
exportText=function(){const t=LiftI18n.t,plan=plans[state.plan];return `${t('MY LIFT PLAN')}\n${t(plan.title)}\n${state.goal?'\n'+t('My goal:')+' '+state.goal+'\n':''}\n${LiftPlanner.tasks(state,plan.tasks).map((item,i)=>`${state.checked.includes(i)?t('[Done]'):'[ ]'} ${i>=4||state.edits[i]?item.title:t(item.title)}\n${i>=4||state.edits[i]?item.detail:t(item.detail)}`).join('\n\n')}\n\n${t('These checkmarks reflect my own progress, not confirmation from a provider.\nI choose whether to share this copy. My own edits are included above.')}\n`;};

let offlineReady=false,offlineBusy=false;
function offlineCard(){
  if(window.LIFT_DOWNLOADED_COPY)return `<section class="content-card"><h2>Your downloaded Lift copy</h2><p>This file contains Lift’s pages and can reopen without a connection. External information websites still need the internet. It contains no personal plan from the website.</p><p class="inline-notice">Keep this file somewhere you trust. Anyone who can access it can open the app. Personal saving depends on the browser; download a plan copy when you need a reliable record.</p><a class="text-button" href="https://lift-next-step.vercel.app/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Visit Lift online for updates</a></section>`;
  if(!['localhost','127.0.0.1'].includes(location.hostname))return `<section class="content-card"><h2>Take a little support offline.</h2><p>Download a small copy of Lift that contains the app in one HTML file. After downloading, open it from your files to use the planner without a connection.</p><a class="secondary" style="margin-top:17px" href="./lift-offline.txt" download="lift-offline.html">Download the offline app</a><p class="inline-notice">This download contains only the app, not your personal plan or edits. Download your plan separately from My next steps if you want a copy. External websites still need a connection.</p><p class="muted-label" style="margin-top:12px">The downloaded app can be opened by anyone with access to the file. Keep personal saving off on shared devices. File-opening support varies by phone and browser.</p></section>`;
  return `<section class="content-card"><h2>A little less dependence on data.</h2><p>Save Lift’s pages for offline use on this browser after a successful online visit. External websites still need a connection.</p><p class="inline-notice">${offlineReady?'An offline copy of the app is available on this browser. Personal plans are only saved if you separately turn on Remember.':'Offline saving is off or has not yet been confirmed. Your personal plan has a separate saving choice below.'}</p><div class="plan-actions" style="margin-top:16px"><button class="secondary" data-action="offline-enable" ${offlineBusy?'disabled':''}>${offlineBusy?'Saving pages…':offlineReady?'Refresh offline pages':'Make Lift available offline'}</button>${offlineReady?'<button class="text-button" data-action="offline-remove">Remove offline copy</button>':''}</div><p class="muted-label" style="margin-top:12px">An offline copy may remain accessible to people using this browser. Private website sign-in does not protect a saved offline copy. Browser storage can also be cleared by your device.</p></section>`;}
const basePrivacyPage=privacy;
privacy=function(){return basePrivacyPage().replace('<div class="page-grid"><div>','<div class="page-grid"><div>'+offlineCard());};

function editTask(index){const isNew=index===null,items=LiftPlanner.tasks(state,plans[state.plan].tasks),item=isNew?{title:'',detail:''}:items[index];if(!item)return;const displayItem=!isNew&&index<4&&!state.edits[index]?{title:LiftI18n.t(item.title),detail:LiftI18n.t(item.detail)}:item;openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Make room for your own words</div><h2 id="dialog-title">${isNew?'Add your own step':'Edit this step'}</h2><p>Keep it short and practical. Please leave out names, document numbers and other private details.</p><form id="task-edit-form" data-index="${isNew?'new':index}"><label class="form-label" for="task-title">What is the step?</label><input class="form-input" id="task-title" name="title" maxlength="120" ${isNew||index>=4||state.edits[index]?'required':''} value="${!isNew&&index<4&&!state.edits[index]?'':escapeText(displayItem.title)}" placeholder="${escapeText(isNew?LiftI18n.t('A small action I can take'):displayItem.title)}"><label class="form-label" for="task-detail">A little more detail <span>(optional)</span></label><textarea class="form-input" id="task-detail" name="detail" maxlength="240" rows="3" placeholder="${escapeText(isNew?'':displayItem.detail)}">${!isNew&&index<4&&!state.edits[index]?'':escapeText(displayItem.detail)}</textarea><p class="dialog-note">${state.remember?'Saving is on. These edits will be kept on this browser.':'Saving is off. These edits stay in this tab until you close or reload it.'}</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" type="submit">Save this step</button><button class="secondary" type="button" data-action="close">Cancel</button>${!isNew&&index>=4?`<button class="text-button" type="button" data-action="remove-task" data-index="${index}">Remove this step</button>`:''}</div></form>`);}
function updateConnection(){const el=document.getElementById('connection-status');el.hidden=navigator.onLine;el.textContent=offlineReady?'You are offline. Saved Lift pages can still work. External websites need a connection.':'You appear to be offline. This open page can still work; reconnect before leaving it.';}
async function refreshOfflineStatus(){try{offlineReady=('caches' in window)&&(await caches.keys()).some(key=>key.startsWith('lift-shell-'));}catch{offlineReady=false;}updateConnection();if(location.hash==='#privacy')route();}
async function enableOffline(){if(!('serviceWorker' in navigator)||!('caches' in window)){toast('This browser does not support offline saving.');return;}offlineBusy=true;closeDialog();route();try{const registration=await navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js',{scope:'./',updateViaCache:'none'});const worker=registration.installing||registration.waiting; if(worker)await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Saving timed out.')),20000);const changed=()=>{if(worker.state==='activated'){clearTimeout(timer);resolve();}if(worker.state==='redundant'){clearTimeout(timer);reject(new Error('Saving failed.'));}};worker.addEventListener('statechange',changed);changed();});if(!worker&&registration.active)await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const channel=new MessageChannel();const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Refresh timed out.')),20000);channel.port1.onmessage=event=>{clearTimeout(timer);channel.port1.close();event.data?.ok?resolve():reject(new Error('Refresh failed.'));};registration.active.postMessage({type:'REFRESH_LIFT_SHELL'},[channel.port2]);});await refreshOfflineStatus();if(!offlineReady)throw new Error('Pages were not saved.');toast('Lift’s app pages are available offline on this browser.');}catch{toast('Offline saving did not complete. Reconnect and try again.');}finally{offlineBusy=false;route();}}
async function removeOffline(){offlineBusy=true;closeDialog();try{if('serviceWorker' in navigator){const registration=await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();if(registration&&[registration.active,registration.waiting,registration.installing].some(worker=>worker?.scriptURL===new URL('./sw.js',location.href).href))await registration.unregister();}if('caches' in window)await Promise.all((await caches.keys()).filter(key=>key.startsWith('lift-shell-')).map(key=>caches.delete(key)));offlineReady=false;toast('The offline app copy has been removed. Your plan has not been changed.');}catch{toast('Could not remove the offline copy. Check this browser’s site storage settings.');}finally{offlineBusy=false;route();updateConnection();}}

document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
  const el=event.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;
  const action=el.dataset.action;
  if(action==='goal-history')showGoalHistory();
  if(action==='focus-next')document.querySelector(`[data-task="${Number(el.dataset.index)}"]`)?.focus();
  if(action==='suggest-goal'&&state.plan){state=LiftPlanner.setGoal(state,LiftI18n.t(plans[state.plan].title));persist();closeDialog();route();}
  if(action==='edit-goal'&&state.plan)openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Your own direction</div><h2 id="dialog-title">What would you like to work toward?</h2><p>A few words are enough. Please leave out private details.</p>${state.goal?`<div class="goal-review"><strong>Before you change your goal</strong><p>You can keep your direction or change it as life changes. Take a moment to review your current goal.</p><p data-user-content>${escapeText(state.goal)}</p><button class="text-button" data-action="goal-history">Review earlier goals</button></div>`:''}<form id="goal-form"><label class="form-label" for="goal-text">My goal <span>(optional)</span></label><button type="button" class="secondary goal-suggestion" data-action="suggest-goal">${plans[state.plan].title}</button><input class="form-input" id="goal-text" name="goal" maxlength="100" value="${escapeText(state.goal)}" placeholder="For example, explore a new skill"><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" type="submit">Save my goal</button><button class="secondary" type="button" data-action="close">Cancel</button></div><p class="dialog-note">${state.remember?'Your goal will be saved on this browser.':'Your goal stays in this tab while saving is off.'}</p></form>`);
  if(action==='edit-task'&&state.plan)editTask(Number(el.dataset.index));
  if(action==='add-task'&&state.plan&&state.custom.length<6)editTask(null);
  if(action==='remove-task'){state=LiftPlanner.removeCustom(state,Number(el.dataset.index));persist();closeDialog();route();toast('Your own step has been removed.');}
  if(action==='review-preparation')openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Review before sharing</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Your conversation checklist</h2><p>Only the text below will be downloaded. Nothing is sent to an organisation.</p><pre class="export-preview" data-user-content>${escapeText(preparationText())}</pre><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="download-preparation">Download checklist</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Keep it here</button></div><p class="dialog-note">A downloaded copy stays in your files and can be read by anyone with access to those files.</p>`);
  if(action==='download-preparation'){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([preparationText()],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}));const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='my-lift-conversation-checklist.txt';document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);closeDialog();toast('Your checklist copy has been downloaded.');}
  if(action==='offline-enable')openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">A choice for this device</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Save Lift’s pages offline?</h2><p>This saves the app’s generic pages on this browser. They may be accessible without signing in while offline. It does not turn on saving for your personal plan or make other websites available offline.</p><p>On a shared device, consider whether you want an offline copy here. You can remove it from My privacy.</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="confirm-offline">Save app pages</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Not now</button></div>`);
  if(action==='confirm-offline')enableOffline();
  if(action==='offline-remove')openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Your choice</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Remove Lift’s offline copy?</h2><p>This removes the saved app pages from this browser. You will need a connection to open Lift again. Your personal plan has a separate saving control.</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="danger-button" data-action="confirm-remove-offline">Remove offline pages</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Keep them</button></div>`);
  if(action==='confirm-remove-offline')removeOffline();
});
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{
  if(event.target.id==='goal-form'){event.preventDefault();state=LiftPlanner.setGoal(state,new FormData(event.target).get('goal'));persist();closeDialog();route();toast('Your goal has been updated.');}
  if(event.target.id==='task-edit-form'){event.preventDefault();const data=new FormData(event.target),indexValue=event.target.dataset.index,defaultItem=indexValue!=='new'&&Number(indexValue)<4&&!state.edits[Number(indexValue)]?plans[state.plan].tasks[Number(indexValue)]:null,title=LiftPlanner.text(data.get('title'),120)||(defaultItem?LiftI18n.t(defaultItem[0]):''),detail=LiftPlanner.text(data.get('detail'),240)||(defaultItem?LiftI18n.t(defaultItem[1]):'');if(!title){document.getElementById('task-title').setCustomValidity(LiftI18n.t('Please give this step a short title.'));event.target.reportValidity();return;}const index=event.target.dataset.index;if(defaultItem&&!LiftPlanner.text(data.get('title'),120)&&!LiftPlanner.text(data.get('detail'),240)){closeDialog();return;}if(index==='new'&&state.custom.length<6)state.custom.push({title,detail});else if(Number(index)<4)state.edits[Number(index)]={title,detail};else if(state.custom[Number(index)-4])state.custom[Number(index)-4]={title,detail};persist();closeDialog();route();toast('Your step has been updated.');}
});
document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(event.target.id==='task-title')event.target.setCustomValidity('');});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.target.matches('[data-prep]')){const i=Number(event.target.dataset.prep);state.prep=event.target.checked?[...new Set([...state.prep,i])]:state.prep.filter(n=>n!==i);persist();route();document.querySelector(`[data-prep="${i}"]`)?.focus();}});
window.addEventListener('online',updateConnection);
window.addEventListener('offline',updateConnection);
route();refreshOfflineStatus();

function showGoalHistory(){
  const history=state.history||[];
  openDialog(`<div class="eyebrow">Goal history</div><h2 id="dialog-title">Earlier goals</h2><p>When you change your goal or choose another plan, Lift keeps the previous goal and progress here.</p><div class="goal-review"><strong>Current goal</strong><p ${state.goal?'data-user-content':''}>${state.goal?escapeText(state.goal):'Goal not set'}</p></div>${history.length?`<ol class="goal-history">${history.map(entry=>`<li><time datetime="${escapeText(entry.changedAt)}">${escapeText(new Date(entry.changedAt).toLocaleString(LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my-MM':'en-GB'))}</time><p>${plans[entry.plan].title}</p><strong ${entry.goal?'data-user-content':''}>${entry.goal?escapeText(entry.goal):'Goal not set'}</strong><p>${LiftI18n.t('{done} of {total} steps',{done:entry.done,total:entry.total})}</p></li>`).join('')}</ol>`:'<p>No earlier goals yet.</p>'}<p class="dialog-note">Up to 20 previous goals are kept. Clearing your Lift plan also clears this history.</p><p class="dialog-note">${state.remember?'Your saved history is visible to anyone using this browser.':'History stays in this tab while saving is off. Turn on Remember in My privacy only on a device you trust.'}</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="close">Close</button><a class="text-button" href="#privacy" data-action="close">My privacy</a></div>`);
}
</script>
<script>'use strict';
const dateCopy={"title": "Keep track of a date", "intro": "Copy a date from your receipt or message. Lift does not calculate or confirm your legal deadline.", "open": "My dates and reminders", "process": "Which process does the receipt name?", "unknown": "I am not sure", "report": "90-day address reporting (TM.47)", "stay": "Extension of stay (TM.7)", "work": "Work permit", "other": "Another process", "date": "Date printed on the receipt or message", "source": "Where did you find this date?", "receipt": "Receipt", "notice": "Official notice", "message": "Message from someone", "confirm": "I have checked that this date matches the receipt or message. This does not confirm that it is an official deadline.", "save": "Keep this date", "empty": "No dates added yet. You can add one without creating a plan.", "privacy": "Dates follow your plan-saving setting. With saving off, they stay in this tab until you close or reload it. Shared-phone users should leave saving off.", "calendar": "Download a calendar reminder", "calendarNote": "This downloads a file; it does not set an alarm automatically. Open it in your calendar and check the date and notification settings. Calendar apps may sync it to your account.", "neutral": "Calendar entries use a neutral title and contain no immigration details.", "event": "Review my saved date", "eventBody": "A date I entered in Lift. It is not a confirmed legal deadline. Check the original source.", "remove": "Remove this date", "error": "Choose a valid date and confirm you checked it against the source.", "full": "You can keep up to six dates. Remove one before adding another.", "past": "This date is in the past. Check the original source; Lift cannot determine whether anything is overdue.", "unverified": "Date entered by you — not independently confirmed", "stored": "This date is saved on this browser because plan saving is on.", "clear": "Clearing your Lift plan also removes your saved dates. Downloaded calendar files remain in your files or calendar.", "review": "Please check the process and date with a trusted adviser if you are unsure. Do not infer your right to stay or work from a reminder."};
function dateLabel(key){return dateCopy[key];}
function datePanel(){
 const dates=LiftDates.normalize(state.dates),today=new Date(),todayISO=[today.getFullYear(),String(today.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),String(today.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')].join('-');
 return `<section class="content-card date-panel"><h2>${dateLabel('title')}</h2><p>${dateLabel('intro')}</p>${dates.length?`<ul class="date-list">${dates.sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).map(d=>`<li><h3><time datetime="${d.date}" data-user-content>${escapeText(d.date)}</time></h3><p>${dateLabel(d.process)} · ${dateLabel(d.source)}</p><small>${dateLabel('unverified')}</small>${d.date<todayISO?`<p class="inline-notice">${dateLabel('past')}</p>`:''}<div class="plan-actions"><button class="secondary" data-action="date-calendar" data-id="${d.id}">${dateLabel('calendar')}</button><button class="text-button" data-action="date-edit" data-id="${d.id}">Edit</button><button class="text-button" data-action="date-remove" data-id="${d.id}">${dateLabel('remove')}</button></div></li>`).join('')}</ul>`:`<p>${dateLabel('empty')}</p>`}<button class="primary" data-action="date-edit">${dateLabel('save')}</button><p class="dialog-note">${dateLabel('privacy')}</p>${state.remember?`<p class="dialog-note">${dateLabel('stored')}</p>`:''}<p class="dialog-note">${dateLabel('clear')}</p></section>`;
}
const datesBaseHome=home;home=function(){return datesBaseHome()+`<section class="content-card"><h2>${dateLabel('title')}</h2><p>${dateLabel('intro')}</p><a class="secondary" href="#steps">${dateLabel('open')}</a></section>`;};
// Dates have one canonical tool on #dates; #steps remains the personal planner.
const datesBasePrivacy=privacy;privacy=function(){return datesBasePrivacy()+`<section class="content-card"><h2>${dateLabel('open')}</h2><p>${dateLabel('privacy')}</p><p>${dateLabel('clear')}</p></section>`;};
function editDate(id){
 const saved=LiftDates.normalize(state.dates).find(d=>d.id===id);if(!saved&&state.dates.length>=6){toast(dateLabel('full'));return;}
 const record=saved||{id:crypto.randomUUID(),date:'',process:'unknown',source:'receipt'};
 openDialog(`<h2 id="dialog-title">${dateLabel('title')}</h2><p>${dateLabel('intro')}</p><form id="date-form" data-id="${record.id}"><label class="form-label" for="date-process">${dateLabel('process')}</label><select class="form-input" id="date-process" name="process">${['unknown','report','stay','work','other'].map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${record.process===k?'selected':''}>${dateLabel(k)}</option>`).join('')}</select><label class="form-label" for="date-value">${dateLabel('date')}</label><input class="form-input" type="date" id="date-value" name="date" min="1900-01-01" max="2200-12-31" required value="${record.date}"><label class="form-label" for="date-source">${dateLabel('source')}</label><select class="form-input" id="date-source" name="source">${['receipt','notice','message'].map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${record.source===k?'selected':''}>${dateLabel(k)}</option>`).join('')}</select><label class="date-confirm"><input type="checkbox" id="date-confirm" required> <span>${dateLabel('confirm')}</span></label><p>${dateLabel('review')}</p><p id="date-error" role="alert"></p><div class="dialog-actions"><button type="submit" class="primary">${dateLabel('save')}</button><button type="button" class="secondary" data-action="close">Cancel</button></div></form>`);
}
function calendarReview(id){const record=LiftDates.normalize(state.dates).find(d=>d.id===id);if(!record)return;openDialog(`<h2 id="dialog-title">${dateLabel('calendar')}</h2><p data-user-content>${record.date}</p><p>${dateLabel('calendarNote')}</p><p>${dateLabel('neutral')}</p><p>${dateLabel('unverified')}</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="date-download" data-id="${record.id}">${dateLabel('calendar')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Cancel</button></div>`);}
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
 const el=event.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;
 if(el.dataset.action==='date-edit')editDate(el.dataset.id);
 if(el.dataset.action==='date-remove'){state.dates=LiftDates.normalize(state.dates).filter(d=>d.id!==el.dataset.id);persist();route();}
 if(el.dataset.action==='date-calendar')calendarReview(el.dataset.id);
 if(el.dataset.action==='date-download'){
  const record=LiftDates.normalize(state.dates).find(d=>d.id===el.dataset.id);if(!record)return;
  const ics=LiftDates.calendar(record,LiftI18n.t(dateLabel('event')),LiftI18n.t(dateLabel('eventBody'))),url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([ics],{type:'text/calendar;charset=utf-8'})),link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='lift-reminder.ics';document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);closeDialog();
 }
});
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{if(event.target.id!=='date-form')return;event.preventDefault();const form=event.target,values=new FormData(form);try{state.dates=LiftDates.keep(state.dates,{id:form.dataset.id,date:values.get('date'),process:values.get('process'),source:values.get('source'),confirmed:document.getElementById('date-confirm').checked});persist();closeDialog();route();}catch(e){document.getElementById('date-error').textContent=LiftI18n.t(dateLabel(e.message==='full'?'full':'error'));}});
route();
</script>

function familyPage(){

 return `${heading('Your next step, together',familyLabel('title'),familyLabel('intro'))}<div class="page-grid"><div><a class="secondary" href="#language">${phaseOneTools.title} ${icon('globe')}</a><section class="content-card"><h2>${familyLabel('choose')}</h2><div class="family-topics">${LiftFamily.topics.map(key=>`<label class="family-choice"><input type="checkbox" data-family-topic="${key}" ${family.topics.includes(key)?'checked':''}><span>${familyLabel(key)}</span></label>`).join('')}</div></section><section class="content-card"><h2>${familyLabel('questions')}</h2><p>${familyLabel('toggle')}</p>${family.topics.length?`<ul class="family-questions">${family.topics.map(key=>`<li><label class="family-choice"><input type="checkbox" data-family-ready="${key}" ${family.ready.includes(key)?'checked':''}><span>${familyLabel(key+'Q')}</span></label></li>`).join('')}</ul><button class="primary" data-action="family-export">${familyLabel('download')}</button>`:`<p role="status">${familyLabel('none')}</p>`}<p class="dialog-note">${familyLabel('privacy')}</p></section><section class="content-card"><h2>${familyLabel('pathways')}</h2><p>${familyLabel('pathwaysText')}</p><ul><li><a href="https://www.unicef.org/thailand/reports/make-learning-count" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${familyLabel('unicef')}</a></li><li><a href="https://core.unesco.org/en/project/567THA1001" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${familyLabel('unesco')}</a></li></ul><p class="dialog-note">${familyLabel('sources')}</p><p>${familyLabel('noPromise')}</p></section></div><aside class="side-column"><section class="plan-card"><h2>${familyLabel('ydc')}</h2><p>${familyLabel('ydcText')}</p><p>${familyLabel('ydcResearch')}</p><a class="secondary" href="https://lift-next-step.vercel.app/survey">${familyLabel('survey')}</a></section><p class="private-note">${familyLabel('adult')}</p></aside></div>`;

const familyBaseHome=home;home=function(){const marker='<div class="section-heading"><div><h2>A path toward a steadier life</h2>',entry=`<section class="content-card family-entry"><h2>${familyLabel('title')}</h2><p>${familyLabel('card')}</p><a class="primary" href="#family">${familyLabel('title')}</a></section>`;return familyBaseHome().replace(marker,entry+marker);};
const familyBaseResources=resourcePage;resourcePage=function(){return familyBaseResources()+`<section class="content-card"><h2>${familyLabel('title')}</h2><p>${familyLabel('card')}</p><a class="secondary" href="#family">${familyLabel('title')}</a></section>`;};
function familyExportText(){const t=key=>LiftI18n.t(familyLabel(key));return [t('exportTitle'),...LiftFamily.questionKeys(state.family).map(t),t('exportNote')].join('\n\n');}
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{
 const input=event.target;if(input.matches('[data-family-topic]')){state.family=LiftFamily.toggleTopic(state.family,input.dataset.familyTopic,input.checked);persist();route();document.querySelector(`[data-family-topic="${input.dataset.familyTopic}"]`)?.focus();}
 if(input.matches('[data-family-ready]')){state.family=LiftFamily.toggleReady(state.family,input.dataset.familyReady,input.checked);persist();route();document.querySelector(`[data-family-ready="${input.dataset.familyReady}"]`)?.focus();}
});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
 const el=event.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;
 if(el.dataset.action==='family-export'&&LiftFamily.questionKeys(state.family).length)openDialog(`<h2 id="dialog-title">${familyLabel('exportTitle')}</h2><pre class="export-preview" data-user-content>${escapeText(familyExportText())}</pre><p>${familyLabel('downloadNote')}</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="primary" data-action="family-download">${familyLabel('downloadFile')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="close">Cancel</button></div>`);
 if(el.dataset.action==='family-download'&&LiftFamily.questionKeys(state.family).length){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([familyExportText()],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'})),link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='lift-learning-questions.txt';document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);closeDialog();}
});
