Object.assign(window.LiftMyanmar,{"Daily spending":"နေ့စဉ်အသုံးစရိတ်","See what remains after the costs you enter. Use amounts for the same period. This is arithmetic, not a bank account or financial advice.":"သင်ထည့်ထားသော ကုန်ကျစရိတ်များကို နုတ်ပြီး ကျန်ငွေကို ကြည့်ပါ။ တူညီသောကာလအတွက် ငွေပမာဏများကို သုံးပါ။ ဤသည်မှာ ဂဏန်းတွက်ချက်မှုသာဖြစ်ပြီး ဘဏ်အကောင့် သို့မဟုတ် ငွေရေးကြေးရေးအကြံဉာဏ် မဟုတ်ပါ။","Which period are these amounts for?":"ဤငွေပမာဏများသည် မည်သည့်ကာလအတွက် ဖြစ်ပါသလဲ။","Today":"ယနေ့","This week":"ယခုအပတ်","This month":"ယခုလ","Amounts in Thai baht (THB). No currency conversion.":"ငွေပမာဏများသည် ထိုင်းဘတ် (THB) ဖြင့် ဖြစ်ပါသည်။ အခြားငွေကြေးသို့ ပြောင်းလဲတွက်ချက်ခြင်း မရှိပါ။","Money available for this period":"ဤကာလအတွက် အသုံးပြုနိုင်သောငွေ","Food":"စားသောက်စရိတ်","Housing and household costs":"နေထိုင်စရိတ်နှင့် အိမ်သုံးစရိတ်","Transport":"သွားလာစရိတ်","Phone and internet":"ဖုန်းနှင့် အင်တာနက်စရိတ်","Other costs":"အခြားကုန်ကျစရိတ်","Calculate what remains":"ကျန်ငွေကို တွက်ချက်ပါ","Clear these amounts":"ဤငွေပမာဏများကို ရှင်းလင်းပါ","Total costs entered":"ထည့်ထားသော ကုန်ကျစရိတ်စုစုပေါင်း","Amount remaining":"ကျန်ငွေပမာဏ","Costs exceed the money entered by":"ထည့်ထားသောငွေထက် ကုန်ကျစရိတ် ပိုနေသည့်ပမာဏ","The costs and available money entered are equal.":"ထည့်ထားသော ကုန်ကျစရိတ်နှင့် အသုံးပြုနိုင်သောငွေ တူညီပါသည်။","This includes only the amounts you enter. It does not check wages, debt, benefits or actual prices.":"သင်ထည့်ထားသော ငွေပမာဏများသာ ပါဝင်ပါသည်။ လုပ်ခ၊ အကြွေး၊ ခံစားခွင့်များ သို့မဟုတ် အမှန်တကယ်ဈေးနှုန်းများကို စစ်ဆေးပေးခြင်း မရှိပါ။","These amounts stay only in this open page, even when plan saving is on. Reloading or closing the page clears them. Lift does not send them anywhere.":"အစီအစဉ်သိမ်းဆည်းမှုကို ဖွင့်ထားသည့်အခါတွင်လည်း ဤငွေပမာဏများသည် ယခုဖွင့်ထားသော စာမျက်နှာထဲတွင်သာ ရှိနေပါသည်။ စာမျက်နှာကို ပြန်လည်တင်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ပိတ်ခြင်းဖြင့် ၎င်းတို့ကို ရှင်းလင်းပစ်ပါသည်။ Lift က ၎င်းတို့ကို မည်သည့်နေရာသို့မျှ မပို့ပါ။","Enter zero or a positive amount with up to two decimal places. Use English or Myanmar digits. The maximum per field is 9,999,999.99 baht.":"သုည သို့မဟုတ် သုညထက်ကြီးသော ငွေပမာဏကို ဒဿမ ၂ နေရာအထိ ထည့်ပါ။ အင်္ဂလိပ် သို့မဟုတ် မြန်မာဂဏန်းများကို သုံးပါ။ ဖြည့်ရန်အကွက်တစ်ခုစီအတွက် အများဆုံး 9,999,999.99 ဘတ်အထိ ထည့်နိုင်ပါသည်။","Enter at least one amount to calculate. Empty fields count as zero.":"တွက်ချက်ရန် အနည်းဆုံး ငွေပမာဏတစ်ခု ထည့်ပါ။ ဗလာထားသောအကွက်များကို သုညအဖြစ် တွက်ပါသည်။","For example, 100":"ဥပမာ၊ 100","Your calculation":"သင့်တွက်ချက်မှုရလဒ်","Change the amounts and calculate again whenever you need. Nothing here is a recommended spending target.":"လိုအပ်သည့်အခါတိုင်း ငွေပမာဏများကို ပြောင်းပြီး ပြန်တွက်နိုင်ပါသည်။ ဤနေရာရှိ မည်သည့်ပမာဏကိုမျှ အသုံးစရိတ်ရည်မှန်းချက်အဖြစ် အကြံပြုထားခြင်း မရှိပါ။"});
/* spending-copy:end */

const spendingCopy={"title": "Daily spending", "intro": "See what remains after the costs you enter. Use amounts for the same period. This is arithmetic, not a bank account or financial advice.", "period": "Which period are these amounts for?", "today": "Today", "week": "This week", "month": "This month", "currency": "Amounts in Thai baht (THB). No currency conversion.", "available": "Money available for this period", "food": "Food", "home": "Housing and household costs", "travel": "Transport", "phone": "Phone and internet", "other": "Other costs", "calculate": "Calculate what remains", "clear": "Clear these amounts", "costs": "Total costs entered", "remaining": "Amount remaining", "shortfall": "Costs exceed the money entered by", "zero": "The costs and available money entered are equal.", "limit": "This includes only the amounts you enter. It does not check wages, debt, benefits or actual prices.", "privacy": "These amounts stay only in this open page, even when plan saving is on. Reloading or closing the page clears them. Lift does not send them anywhere.", "error": "Enter zero or a positive amount with up to two decimal places. Use English or Myanmar digits. The maximum per field is 9,999,999.99 baht.", "empty": "Enter at least one amount to calculate. Empty fields count as zero.", "blank": "For example, 100", "result": "Your calculation", "edit": "Change the amounts and calculate again whenever you need. Nothing here is a recommended spending target."};
// Session memory only: deliberately excluded from planner state and persistence.
let spendingDraft={period:'today',values:{},result:null,error:null};
function spendingLabel(key){return LiftI18n.locale==='my'?spendingMyanmar[key]:spendingCopy[key];}
function spendingMoney(cents){return new Intl.NumberFormat(document.documentElement.lang==='my'?'my-MM':'en',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(cents/100)+' THB';}
function spendingConnections(){return `<nav class="spending-connections companion-secondary" aria-label="${escapeText(LiftI18n.t('My next steps'))}">${[['daily','people',everydayLabel('title')],['dates','steps',dateLabel('open')],['family','learn',familyLabel('title')],['community','people',communityLabel('title')]].map(([path,symbol,label])=>`<a href="#${path}">${icon(symbol)}<span>${escapeText(LiftI18n.t(label))}</span>${icon('arrow')}</a>`).join('')}</nav>`;}
function spendingResult(){const r=spendingDraft.result;if(!r)return '';const rows=LiftSpending.fields.slice(1).map(key=>({key,amount:LiftSpending.parse(spendingDraft.values[key]||'')||0})).filter(row=>row.amount>0).sort((a,b)=>b.amount-a.amount);return `<section class="spending-result content-card" aria-labelledby="spending-result-title"><h2 id="spending-result-title">${spendingLabel('result')}</h2><p>${spendingLabel('period')} <strong>${spendingLabel(spendingDraft.period)}</strong></p><dl><div><dt>${spendingLabel('available')}</dt><dd data-user-content>${spendingMoney(r.available)}</dd></div><div><dt>${spendingLabel('costs')}</dt><dd data-user-content>${spendingMoney(r.costs)}</dd></div><div><dt>${spendingLabel(r.remaining<0?'shortfall':'remaining')}</dt><dd data-user-content>${spendingMoney(Math.abs(r.remaining))}</dd></div></dl>${r.remaining===0?`<p>${spendingLabel('zero')}</p>`:''}${rows.length?`<details class="spending-breakdown" open><summary>${spendingLabel('costs')}</summary><dl>${rows.map(row=>`<div><dt>${spendingLabel(row.key)}</dt><dd data-user-content>${spendingMoney(row.amount)} · ${new Intl.NumberFormat(document.documentElement.lang==='my'?'my-MM':'en',{style:'percent',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(row.amount/r.costs)}</dd></div>`).join('')}</dl></details>`:''}<p>${spendingLabel('limit')}</p><button type="button" class="primary" data-cash-open>${escapeText(typeof learningText==='function'?learningText('cash_title'):spendingLabel('title'))}${icon('arrow')}</button><h3>${LiftI18n.t('My next steps')}</h3>${spendingConnections()}<p>${spendingLabel('edit')}</p></section>`;}
function spendingPage(){return `${heading('One thing at a time',spendingLabel('title'),spendingLabel('intro'))}<details class="spending-privacy"><summary>My privacy</summary><p>${spendingLabel('privacy')}</p></details><form id="spending-form" class="content-card spending-form" method="dialog" novalidate><label class="form-label" for="spending-period">${spendingLabel('period')}</label><select class="form-input" id="spending-period" name="period">${['today','week','month'].map(key=>`<option value="${key}" ${spendingDraft.period===key?'selected':''}>${spendingLabel(key)}</option>`).join('')}</select><p class="dialog-note">${spendingLabel('currency')}</p><div class="spending-fields">${LiftSpending.fields.map((key,i)=>`<div class="spending-field ${i===0?'spending-available':''}"><label class="form-label" for="spending-${key}">${icon(['money','heart','home','globe','people','steps'][i])}${spendingLabel(key)}</label><input class="form-input" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" maxlength="16" id="spending-${key}" name="${key}" data-spending-input value="${escapeText(spendingDraft.values[key]||'')}" placeholder="${spendingLabel('blank')}" aria-describedby="spending-input-help spending-error"></div>`).join('')}</div><p id="spending-input-help" class="dialog-note">${spendingLabel('empty')}</p><p id="spending-error" role="alert">${spendingDraft.error?spendingLabel(spendingDraft.error):''}</p><div class="plan-actions"><button class="primary" type="submit">${spendingLabel('calculate')}</button><button class="secondary" type="button" data-action="spending-clear">${spendingLabel('clear')}</button></div></form><div id="spending-output" aria-live="polite" tabindex="-1">${spendingResult()}</div><p class="dialog-note">${spendingLabel('limit')}</p>`;}
document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(!event.target.matches('[data-spending-input]'))return;spendingDraft.values[event.target.name]=event.target.value;spendingDraft.result=null;spendingDraft.error=null;event.target.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');document.getElementById('spending-output').innerHTML='';document.getElementById('spending-error').textContent='';});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.target.id==='spending-period'){spendingDraft.period=event.target.value;spendingDraft.result=null;document.getElementById('spending-output').innerHTML='';}});
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{if(event.target.id!=='spending-form')return;event.preventDefault();const form=event.target;spendingDraft.result=null;for(const input of form.querySelectorAll('[data-spending-input]'))input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');try{spendingDraft.result=LiftSpending.calculate(spendingDraft.values);spendingDraft.error=null;document.getElementById('spending-error').textContent='';document.getElementById('spending-output').innerHTML=spendingResult();LiftI18n.render();document.getElementById('spending-output').focus();}catch(error){spendingDraft.error=error.message==='empty'?'empty':'error';document.getElementById('spending-output').innerHTML='';document.getElementById('spending-error').textContent=LiftI18n.t(spendingLabel(spendingDraft.error));for(const input of form.querySelectorAll('[data-spending-input]')){try{LiftSpending.parse(input.value);}catch{input.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true');input.focus();break;}}}});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const action=event.target.closest('[data-action]')?.dataset.action;if(action==='spending-clear'||action==='confirm-clear'){spendingDraft={period:'today',values:{},result:null,error:null};if(action==='spending-clear'){route();document.getElementById('spending-available')?.focus();}}});
</script>
<script>'use strict';
/* everyday-copy:start */

const everydayCopy={"title":"Everyday questions","intro":"Choose a situation, then tick the questions you want to ask. You do not need to write or share personal details.","housing":"Housing","transport":"Transport","phone":"Phone and internet","food":"Food and everyday shopping","housing1":"What is the total cost, including utilities and any other charges?","housing2":"What are the deposit, payment and refund conditions? Can I have them in writing?","housing3":"Who can I contact about repairs or a problem, and how?","transport1":"Does this service go to my destination, and where should I get off?","transport2":"What is the total fare, and when is the last return service?","transport3":"How can I confirm the route and pickup point before travelling?","phone1":"What is the full cost, how much data is included, and when does it expire?","phone2":"Does this renew automatically? How can I check the balance or stop renewal?","phone3":"If documents or information are requested, why are they needed and who receives them?","food1":"What is the total price and quantity before I agree to buy?","food2":"Does this food contain an ingredient I need to avoid?","food3":"Can I check the expiry date or return conditions before paying?","selected":"Questions I chose","none":"Tick at least one question to make your checklist.","download":"Download my questions","clear":"Clear my choices","privacy":"Your choices stay in this open page until you reload or close it. Lift does not upload them. If you choose to share, the app you select handles that copy. Downloaded files and copied text can remain on your device.","limits":"These are conversation prompts, not verified prices, service recommendations or legal, medical or financial advice. Confirm answers directly with the relevant provider.","language":"The checklist uses the language you selected in Lift. You can use the external translation tools if you need another language.","exportTitle":"My everyday questions — prepared in Lift","copyNote":"No answers, personal details or provider information are included in this checklist.","copy":"Copy my questions","copied":"Your questions were copied. The text may remain in this device’s clipboard.","copyFailed":"Copy did not work. You can download your questions instead.","share":"Share my questions","shareHelp":"Your selected questions and Lift’s explanatory notes are included. No plan or spending amounts are included. Choose the app and recipient in your phone’s sharing menu. Shared copies stay outside Lift.","shareUnavailable":"Sharing is not available here. You can copy or download your questions instead.","shareReturned":"The sharing menu has closed. This does not confirm that anyone received your questions."};
// Only fixed question IDs are kept in memory. No provider, answer or personal fields.
let everydaySelected=[];
const everydayOpenTopics=new Set();
const everydayTopics=['housing','transport','phone','food'];
const everydayQuestionKeys=everydayTopics.flatMap(topic=>[1,2,3].map(n=>topic+n));
icons.share='<path d="M12 15V3m-4 4 4-4 4 4M5 12v7a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/>';
icons.copy='<rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M16 8V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v9a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3"/>';
icons.bus='<rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="15" rx="4"/><path d="M4 11h16M8 18v3m8-3v3M8 7h8M8 15h.01M16 15h.01"/>';
icons.phone='<rect x="6" y="2" width="12" height="20" rx="3"/><path d="M10 5h4m-3 14h2"/>';
icons.basket='<path d="m3 9 2 12h14l2-12ZM8 9l4-7 4 7M9 13v4m6-4v4"/>';
function everydayLabel(key){return LiftI18n.locale==='my'?everydayMyanmar[key]:everydayCopy[key];}
function everydaySelection(){return everydaySelected.length?`<ul class="everyday-chosen">${everydayQuestionKeys.filter(key=>everydaySelected.includes(key)).map(key=>`<li>${everydayLabel(key)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`:`<p>${everydayLabel('none')}</p>`;}
function everydayPage(){return `${heading('One thing at a time',everydayLabel('title'),everydayLabel('intro'))}<div class="everyday-topics">${everydayTopics.map((topic,i)=>`<details class="everyday-topic" data-everyday-topic="${topic}" ${everydayOpenTopics.has(topic)?'open':''}><summary><span class="topic-vector">${icon(['home','bus','phone','basket'][i])}</span><span>${everydayLabel(topic)}</span></summary><div class="everyday-options">${[1,2,3].map(n=>{const key=topic+n;return `<label class="everyday-choice"><input type="checkbox" data-everyday-question="${key}" ${everydaySelected.includes(key)?'checked':''}><span>${everydayLabel(key)}</span></label>`;}).join('')}</div></details>`).join('')}</div><section class="content-card everyday-review"><h2>${everydayLabel('selected')}</h2><div id="everyday-selected" aria-live="polite">${everydaySelection()}</div><p>${everydayLabel('language')}</p><p class="dialog-note">${everydayLabel('shareHelp')}</p><div class="plan-actions"><button class="secondary" data-action="everyday-share" ${everydaySelected.length?'':'disabled'}>${icon('share')}${everydayLabel('share')}</button><button class="primary" data-action="everyday-copy" ${everydaySelected.length?'':'disabled'}>${everydayLabel('copy')} ${icon('copy')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="everyday-download" ${everydaySelected.length?'':'disabled'}>${everydayLabel('download')}</button><button class="secondary" data-action="everyday-clear">${everydayLabel('clear')}</button><a class="text-button" href="#language">${phaseOneTools.title}</a></div><p id="everyday-copy-status" role="status"></p></section><details><summary>My privacy</summary><p>${everydayLabel('privacy')}</p></details><p class="dialog-note">${everydayLabel('limits')}</p>`;}
function everydayExport(){const t=key=>LiftI18n.t(everydayLabel(key));return [t('exportTitle'),'',...everydayQuestionKeys.filter(key=>everydaySelected.includes(key)).map((key,i)=>`${i+1}. ${t(key)}`),'',t('copyNote'),t('limits')].join('\n');}
let everydaySharing=false;
async function shareEverydayQuestions(){
 if(!everydaySelected.length||everydaySharing)return;
 const status=document.getElementById('everyday-copy-status');
 const selection=everydaySelected.join('|'),locale=LiftI18n.locale;
 const button=document.querySelector('[data-action="everyday-share"]');
 let message='';everydaySharing=true;if(button)button.disabled=true;
 try{
  if(typeof navigator.share!=='function')message='shareUnavailable';
  else{await navigator.share({title:everydayLabel('title'),text:everydayExport()});message='shareReturned';}
 }catch(error){if(error?.name!=='AbortError')message='shareUnavailable';}
 finally{
  everydaySharing=false;
  if(button?.isConnected)button.disabled=!everydaySelected.length;
  if(status&&document.getElementById('everyday-copy-status')===status&&selection===everydaySelected.join('|')&&locale===LiftI18n.locale)status.textContent=message?LiftI18n.t(everydayLabel(message)):'';
 }
}
document.addEventListener('toggle',event=>{const topic=event.target.dataset?.everydayTopic;if(!everydayTopics.includes(topic))return;if(event.target.open)everydayOpenTopics.add(topic);else everydayOpenTopics.delete(topic);},true);
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{const key=event.target.dataset.everydayQuestion;if(!everydayQuestionKeys.includes(key))return;everydaySelected=event.target.checked?[...new Set([...everydaySelected,key])]:everydaySelected.filter(x=>x!==key);document.getElementById('everyday-selected').innerHTML=everydaySelection();document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="everyday-download"],[data-action="everyday-copy"],[data-action="everyday-share"]').forEach(button=>button.disabled=!everydaySelected.length);document.getElementById('everyday-copy-status').textContent='';LiftI18n.render();});
document.addEventListener('click',async event=>{const action=event.target.closest('[data-action]')?.dataset.action;if(action==='everyday-clear'||action==='confirm-clear'){everydaySelected=[];everydayOpenTopics.clear();if(action==='everyday-clear'){route();document.querySelector('[data-action="everyday-clear"]')?.focus();}}if(action==='everyday-share')await shareEverydayQuestions();if(action==='everyday-copy'&&everydaySelected.length){let message='copied';try{if(!navigator.clipboard?.writeText)throw Error('unsupported');await navigator.clipboard.writeText(everydayExport());}catch{message='copyFailed';}const status=document.getElementById('everyday-copy-status');if(status)status.textContent=LiftI18n.t(everydayLabel(message));} if(action==='everyday-download'&&everydaySelected.length){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([everydayExport()],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}));const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='lift-everyday-questions.txt';document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}});
</script>
<script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 const topics=['daily','family','work','documents','health'];
 function normalize(value){return {kind:value?.kind==='experience'?'experience':'question',topic:topics.includes(value?.topic)?value.topic:'daily',text:typeof value?.text==='string'?value.text.slice(0,1200):''};}
 function valid(value){return typeof value?.text==='string'&&value.text.trim().length>0&&value.text.length<=1200&&topics.includes(value.topic)&&['question','experience'].includes(value.kind);}
 function appendPrompt(value,prompt){
  const draft=normalize(value);if(typeof prompt!=='string'||!prompt.trim())return {draft,status:'invalid'};
  const text=prompt.trim();if(draft.text.split('\n').some(line=>line.trim()===text))return {draft,status:'duplicate'};
  const next=draft.text.trim()?draft.text+'\n\n'+text:text;
  return next.length>1200?{draft,status:'full'}:{draft:{...draft,text:next},status:'added'};
 }
 function replacePrompt(value,previous,prompt){
  const draft=normalize(value),text=typeof prompt==='string'?prompt.trim():'';
  const base=previous?{...draft,text:draft.text.split('\n\n').filter(part=>part!==previous).join('\n\n')}:draft;
  if(!text)return {draft:base,status:'cleared',owned:false};
  const next=appendPrompt(base,text);
  if(next.status==='full'||next.status==='invalid')return {draft,status:next.status,owned:false};
  return {...next,owned:next.status==='added'};
 }
 function exportText(value,label){if(!valid(value))throw Error('Invalid draft');return [label('previewTitle'),label(value.kind),label(value.topic),value.text.trim(),label('draftNote')].join('\n\n');}
 function overdue(due,now=new Date()){const end=Date.parse(due+'T23:59:59Z');return !Number.isFinite(end)||now.getTime()>end;}
 const api={topics,normalize,valid,appendPrompt,replacePrompt,exportText,overdue};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCommunity=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>

Please do not name agents or employers.":"အမည်များ၊ ဖုန်းနံပါတ်များ၊ စာရွက်စာတမ်းနံပါတ်များ၊ လိပ်စာအတိအကျနှင့် အခြားသူတစ်ဦးကို ဖော်ထုတ်နိုင်သော အသေးစိတ်အချက်များကို မထည့်ပါနှင့်။ အကျိုးဆောင်များ သို့မဟုတ် အလုပ်ရှင်များ၏ အမည်များကို မဖော်ပြပါနှင့်။","Your draft stays only in this open page. Reloading or clearing removes it, even if plan saving is on. Text you copy, download or share remains outside Lift.":"သင့်မူကြမ်းသည် ယခုဖွင့်ထားသော စာမျက်နှာထဲတွင်သာ ရှိနေပါသည်။ အစီအစဉ်သိမ်းဆည်းမှု ဖွင့်ထားလျှင်လည်း စာမျက်နှာကို ပြန်လည်တင်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းလင်းခြင်းဖြင့် မူကြမ်းကို ဖယ်ရှားပါသည်။ သင်ကူးယူ၊ ဒေါင်းလုဒ်လုပ် သို့မဟုတ် မျှဝေထားသော စာသားသည် Lift ပြင်ပတွင် ကျန်ရှိပါသည်။","Review my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းကို ပြန်ကြည့်ပါ","Your draft — not reviewed":"သင့်မူကြမ်း — မစိစစ်ရသေးပါ","This is a personal question or experience, not verified information. It has not been reviewed or published by Lift.":"ဤသည်မှာ ကိုယ်ပိုင်မေးခွန်း သို့မဟုတ် အတွေ့အကြုံဖြစ်ပြီး အတည်ပြုထားသော အချက်အလက် မဟုတ်ပါ။ Lift က စိစစ်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ထုတ်ဝေခြင်း မပြုရသေးပါ။","Share my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းကို မျှဝေပါ","Copy my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းကို ကူးယူပါ","Download my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းကို ဒေါင်းလုဒ်လုပ်ပါ","Clear my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းကို ရှင်းလင်းပါ","Edit my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းကို ပြင်ဆင်ပါ","Write a question or experience first.":"မေးခွန်း သို့မဟုတ် အတွေ့အကြုံတစ်ခုကို ဦးစွာ ရေးပါ။","Please keep your draft within 1,200 characters.":"မူကြမ်းကို စာလုံးရေ 1,200 အတွင်း ရေးပါ။","You choose the app and recipient. Sharing does not submit a draft to Lift and does not make it a reviewed community post.":"အက်ပ်နှင့် လက်ခံမည့်သူကို သင်ရွေးချယ်ပါသည်။ မျှဝေခြင်းသည် မူကြမ်းကို Lift ထံ ပေးပို့ခြင်း မဟုတ်သကဲ့သို့ စိစစ်ပြီးသော အသိုင်းအဝိုင်းပို့စ်အဖြစ် ပြောင်းလဲခြင်းလည်း မဟုတ်ပါ။","Sharing is unavailable. You can copy or download your draft instead.":"မျှဝေ၍ မရပါ။ အစားထိုးအနေဖြင့် သင့်မူကြမ်းကို ကူးယူနိုင်ပါသည် သို့မဟုတ် ဒေါင်းလုဒ်လုပ်နိုင်ပါသည်။","Draft copied. You choose where to paste it.":"မူကြမ်းကို ကူးယူပြီးပါပြီ။ မည်သည့်နေရာတွင် ထည့်မည်ကို သင်ရွေးချယ်ပါသည်။","Copying is unavailable. You can download your draft instead.":"ကူးယူ၍ မရပါ။ အစားထိုးအနေဖြင့် သင့်မူကြမ်းကို ဒေါင်းလုဒ်လုပ်နိုင်ပါသည်။","Your draft was cleared from this page.":"သင့်မူကြမ်းကို ဤစာမျက်နှာမှ ရှင်းလင်းပြီးပါပြီ။","Reviewed community information":"စိစစ်ပြီးသော အသိုင်းအဝိုင်းအချက်အလက်များ","There are no reviewed community posts yet. Personal drafts are never added automatically.":"စိစစ်ပြီးသော အသိုင်းအဝိုင်းပို့စ်များ မရှိသေးပါ။ ကိုယ်ပိုင်မူကြမ်းများကို အလိုအလျောက် ထည့်သွင်းခြင်း လုံးဝမရှိပါ။","Before publication, a person must check the wording, remove identifying details and check sources. Legal and health information also needs a qualified reviewer. Experiences must be labelled as experiences.":"မထုတ်ဝေမီ လူတစ်ဦးက အသုံးအနှုန်းများကို စိစစ်ခြင်း၊ မည်သူဖြစ်ကြောင်း ဖော်ထုတ်နိုင်သော အချက်များကို ဖယ်ရှားခြင်းနှင့် ရင်းမြစ်များကို စစ်ဆေးခြင်း ပြုလုပ်ရပါမည်။ ဥပဒေနှင့် ကျန်းမာရေးအချက်အလက်များအတွက် သက်ဆိုင်ရာအရည်အချင်းရှိသော စိစစ်သူလည်း လိုအပ်ပါသည်။ အတွေ့အကြုံများကို အတွေ့အကြုံဖြစ်ကြောင်း တပ်ဖော်ပြရပါမည်။","Read the source":"ရင်းမြစ်ကို ဖတ်ပါ","Reviewed on":"စိစစ်ခဲ့သည့်ရက်","Review due":"ပြန်လည်စိစစ်ရမည့်ရက်","Review is overdue. Check the original source before relying on this post.":"ပြန်လည်စိစစ်ရမည့်ရက် ကျော်လွန်နေပါသည်။ ဤပို့စ်ကို မမှီခိုမီ မူရင်းရင်းမြစ်ကို စစ်ဆေးပါ။","Personal experience — may not apply to you":"ကိုယ်ပိုင်အတွေ့အကြုံ — သင့်အခြေအနေနှင့် ကိုက်ညီချင်မှ ကိုက်ညီပါမည်","Source-backed information":"ရင်းမြစ်အထောက်အထားရှိသော အချက်အလက်","This page is not monitored and cannot provide urgent help. Use a support service directly when you need assistance.":"ဤစာမျက်နှာကို စောင့်ကြည့်နေသူ မရှိသဖြင့် အရေးပေါ်အကူအညီ မပေးနိုင်ပါ။ အကူအညီလိုအပ်သည့်အခါ အကူအညီပေးသော ဝန်ဆောင်မှုကို တိုက်ရိုက် အသုံးပြုပါ။","Find support information":"အကူအညီဆိုင်ရာ အချက်အလက်ကို ရှာပါ","Back to my draft":"ကျွန်ုပ်၏မူကြမ်းသို့ ပြန်သွားပါ"});
/* community-copy:end */
function communityLabel(key){return LiftI18n.locale==='my'?communityMyanmar[key]:communityCopy[key];}
let communityDraft=LiftCommunity.normalize(),communityPreview=false,communityBusy=false;
function communityExport(){return LiftCommunity.exportText(communityDraft,communityLabel);}
function communityBoard(){const posts=window.LiftCommunityPosts||[];return `<section class="content-card"><h2>${communityLabel('board')}</h2>${posts.length?posts.map(p=>`<article class="community-post"><p class="community-badge">${communityLabel(p.kind==='experience'?'experienceLabel':'answerLabel')}</p><h3 data-user-content>${escapeText(p.title[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'])}</h3><p class="community-body" data-user-content>${escapeText(p.body[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'])}</p><p class="community-post-meta"><span>${icon('check')}${communityLabel('reviewed')}: ${escapeText(p.reviewedAt)}</span><span>${icon('steps')}${communityLabel('due')}: ${escapeText(p.reviewDue)}</span></p>${LiftCommunity.overdue(p.reviewDue)?`<p role="note">${communityLabel('stale')}</p>`:''}<div class="community-post-sources">${p.sources.map(url=>`<a href="${escapeText(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${icon('book')}${communityLabel('source')}</a>`).join(' ')}</div></article>`).join(''):`<p>${communityLabel('noPosts')}</p>`}<details><summary>${communityLabel('reviewExplain')}</summary><p>${communityLabel('notEmergency')}</p></details></section>`;}
function communityPromptChoices(){if(typeof everydayLabel!=='function')return '';return `<details class="community-prompt-picker"><summary>${everydayLabel('title')}</summary>${['housing','transport','phone','food'].map((topic,i)=>`<details><summary>${icon(['home','bus','phone','basket'][i])}${everydayLabel(topic)}</summary><div class="community-prompt-list">${[1,2,3].map(n=>{const key=topic+n,label=everydayLabel(key),chosen=communityDraft.text.split('\n').some(line=>line.trim()===label);return `<button type="button" class="secondary" data-community-prompt="${key}" ${chosen?'disabled':''}>${escapeText(label)}</button>`;}).join('')}</div></details>`).join('')}</details>`;}
function communityPage(){const c=communityLabel;return heading('Your next step, together',c('title'),'')+`<p class="community-status" role="note">${icon('shield')}<span data-community-notice>${c('status')}</span></p><section class="content-card community-compose">${communityPreview?`<h2 tabindex="-1">${c('previewTitle')}</h2><pre class="export-preview community-body" data-user-content>${escapeText(communityExport())}</pre><p>${c('shareHelp')}</p><div class="community-actions"><button type="button" class="primary" data-community-action="share">${c('share')}</button><button type="button" class="secondary" data-community-action="copy">${c('copy')}</button><button type="button" class="secondary" data-community-action="download">${c('download')}</button><button type="button" class="text-button" data-community-action="edit">${c('edit')}</button></div>`:`${communityPromptChoices()}<form id="community-form" method="dialog"><label for="community-kind">${c('kind')}</label><select id="community-kind" data-community-field="kind">${['question','experience'].map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${communityDraft.kind===k?'selected':''}>${c(k)}</option>`).join('')}</select><label for="community-topic">${c('topic')}</label><select id="community-topic" data-community-field="topic">${LiftCommunity.topics.map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${communityDraft.topic===k?'selected':''}>${c(k)}</option>`).join('')}</select>${typeof communityChoiceFields==='function'?communityChoiceFields():''}<label for="community-text">${c('prompt')}</label><textarea id="community-text" data-community-field="text" maxlength="1200" rows="5" placeholder="${escapeText(c('placeholder'))}" aria-describedby="community-safety community-limit" data-user-content>${escapeText(communityDraft.text)}</textarea><p id="community-limit" class="community-count" aria-live="off">${communityDraft.text.length} / 1200</p><p id="community-safety">${c('safety')}</p><button type="submit" class="primary">${c('preview')}</button></form>`}<button type="button" class="text-button" data-community-action="clear">${c('clear')}</button><p class="community-privacy">${c('privacy')}</p><p id="community-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p></section>${communityBoard()}<a class="secondary" href="#resources" data-resource-topic="support">${c('help')}</a>`;}
function communityFeedback(key){const el=document.getElementById('community-feedback');if(el)el.textContent=communityLabel(key);}
document.addEventListener('input',event=>{const key=event.target.dataset.communityField;if(!key)return;communityDraft=LiftCommunity.normalize({...communityDraft,[key]:event.target.value});if(key==='text'){const el=document.getElementById('community-limit');if(el)el.textContent=communityDraft.text.length+' / 1200';}});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{const key=event.target.dataset.communityField;if(key)communityDraft=LiftCommunity.normalize({...communityDraft,[key]:event.target.value});});
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{if(event.target.id!=='community-form')return;event.preventDefault();if(!LiftCommunity.valid(communityDraft)){communityFeedback('empty');document.getElementById('community-text')?.focus();return;}communityPreview=true;route();const title=document.querySelector('.community-compose h2');title?.focus();title?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});});
document.addEventListener('click',async event=>{
 const promptControl=event.target.closest('[data-community-prompt]');
 if(promptControl){const key=promptControl.dataset.communityPrompt;if(!/^(housing|transport|phone|food)[123]$/.test(key))return;const result=LiftCommunity.appendPrompt(communityDraft,everydayLabel(key));if(result.status==='full'){communityFeedback('tooLong');return;}if(result.status==='added'){communityDraft=result.draft;communityPreview=false;route();document.getElementById('community-text')?.focus();}return;}
 const control=event.target.closest('[data-community-action]');
 if(event.target.closest('[data-action="confirm-clear"]')){communityDraft=LiftCommunity.normalize();communityPreview=false;return;}
 if(!control)return;const action=control.dataset.communityAction;
 if(action==='clear'){communityDraft=LiftCommunity.normalize();communityPreview=false;route();communityFeedback('cleared');return;}
 if(action==='edit'){communityPreview=false;route();document.getElementById('community-text')?.focus();return;}
 if(!communityPreview||!LiftCommunity.valid(communityDraft)||communityBusy)return;
 const text=communityExport(),feedback=document.getElementById('community-feedback'),locale=LiftI18n.locale;
 function report(key){if(feedback?.isConnected&&LiftI18n.locale===locale)feedback.textContent=communityLabel(key);}
 if(action==='download'){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'})),link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='lift-community-draft.txt';document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);return;}
 communityBusy=true;control.disabled=true;
 try{if(action==='share'){if(!navigator.share){report('fallback');return;}await navigator.share({title:communityLabel('previewTitle'),text});}else if(action==='copy'){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);report('copied');}}catch(error){if(error.name!=='AbortError')report(action==='share'?'fallback':'copyFailed');}finally{communityBusy=false;if(control.isConnected)control.disabled=false;}
});
</script>
<script>'use strict';
// Choices add personal draft lines; they never become reviewed advice.
const originalCommunityPrompts=communityPromptChoices;
let communityPicked={question:null,answer:null};
function liftChoiceLabel(key){return window.LiftChoiceCopy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'][key];}
function communityChoiceText(key){if(/^(housing|transport|phone|food)[123]$/.test(key))return everydayLabel(key);return ['qHelp','qAsk','qExperience','aNeed','aCompare','aExperience','aUnsure'].includes(key)?liftChoiceLabel(key):null;}
function communityPickedKey(field){const picked=communityPicked[field];return picked&&communityDraft.text.split('\n').some(line=>line.trim()===picked.text)?picked.key:'';}
communityPromptChoices=function(){return `<p class="community-choice-hint">${liftChoiceLabel('pickHint')}</p>`;};
function communityChoiceKeys(){if(communityDraft.kind==='experience')return ['aExperience'];return communityDraft.topic==='daily'?['qHelp','qAsk','qExperience',...['housing','transport','phone','food'].flatMap(topic=>[1,2,3].map(n=>topic+n))]:['qHelp','qAsk','qExperience'];}

<script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 function validReceipt(value){return typeof value==='string'&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(value);}
 function parseResponse(body){
  if(!body||typeof body!=='object'||!['received','answered','withdrawn','expired','not_found','closed','conflict','retry','rate_limited','unavailable'].includes(body.status))throw Error('Unconfirmed response');
  if(['received','answered'].includes(body.status)){
   if(body.ok!==true||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(body.submittedAt))||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(body.expiresAt)))throw Error('Unconfirmed response');
   const result={status:body.status,submittedAt:body.submittedAt,expiresAt:body.expiresAt};
   if(body.status==='answered'){
    const r=body.reply;if(!r||!['en','my'].every(k=>typeof r[k]==='string'&&r[k].trim()&&r[k].length<=2400)||!Array.isArray(r.sources)||r.sources.length<1||r.sources.length>5||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(body.reviewedAt)))throw Error('Unconfirmed reply');
    for(const source of r.sources){const u=new URL(source);if(u.protocol!=='https:'||u.username||u.password)throw Error('Unconfirmed source');}
    result.reply={en:r.en,my:r.my,sources:[...r.sources]};result.reviewedAt=body.reviewedAt;
   }
   return result;
  }
  if(body.status==='withdrawn'&&body.ok!==true)throw Error('Unconfirmed withdrawal');return {status:body.status};
 }
 function createClient({fetchImpl=root.fetch?.bind(root),cryptoImpl=root.crypto,online=()=>root.navigator?.onLine!==false,timeoutMs=15000}={}){
  if(!Number.isFinite(timeoutMs)||timeoutMs<1||timeoutMs>60000)throw Error('Invalid request timeout');
  let pending=null,busy=false;
  function begin(draft,consent){
   if(busy||pending)throw Error('A receipt is already pending');
   if(!draft||!['question','experience'].includes(draft.kind)||!['daily','family','work','documents','health'].includes(draft.topic)||typeof draft.text!=='string'||!draft.text.trim()||draft.text.length>1200||!['en','my'].includes(draft.language)||consent?.adult!==true||consent.review!==true||typeof consent.ai!=='boolean')throw Error('Consent or draft invalid');
   if(!cryptoImpl?.getRandomValues)throw Error('Secure receipt unavailable');const bytes=cryptoImpl.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
   const receipt=btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes)).replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');
   pending={version:1,action:'submit',receipt,kind:draft.kind,topic:draft.topic,text:draft.text.trim(),language:draft.language,adult:true,consentToReview:true,consentToAI:consent.ai};return receipt;
  }
  async function request(body){
   if(busy)throw Error('Request already running');if(!online())return {status:'offline'};if(typeof fetchImpl!=='function')return {status:'unavailable'};
   busy=true;let timer;const controller=typeof root.AbortController==='function'?new root.AbortController():null;
   const deadline=new Promise(resolve=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>{resolve({status:'unavailable'});controller?.abort();},timeoutMs);});
   async function perform(){try{const response=await fetchImpl('/api/community',{method:'POST',credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',redirect:'error',signal:controller?.signal,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});
    const result=parseResponse(await response.json());if(response.status>=500&&result.status!=='closed')return {status:'unavailable'};
    const expected={received:200,answered:200,withdrawn:200,expired:410,not_found:404,closed:503,conflict:409,retry:409,rate_limited:429,unavailable:503};
    if(expected[result.status]!==response.status)throw Error('Unexpected response status');return result;
   }catch{return {status:'unavailable'};}}
   try{return await Promise.race([perform(),deadline]);}finally{clearTimeout(timer);busy=false;}
  }
  return {begin,receipt:()=>pending?.receipt||null,isBusy:()=>busy,send:()=>{if(!pending)throw Error('No prepared submission');return request({...pending});},check:receipt=>{if(!validReceipt(receipt))throw Error('Invalid receipt');return request({version:1,action:'status',receipt});},withdraw:receipt=>{if(!validReceipt(receipt))throw Error('Invalid receipt');return request({version:1,action:'withdraw',receipt});}};
 }
 const api={validReceipt,parseResponse,createClient};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCommunityIntakeClient=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 const KEY='lift-private-community-receipt-v1',TTL=14*86400000;
 const valid=value=>typeof value==='string'&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(value);
 function createStore({storage,now=()=>Date.now()}={}){
  function forget(){try{storage?.removeItem(KEY);return true;}catch{return false;}}
  function load(){try{const value=JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(KEY)||'null');if(!value)return null;if(!valid(value.receipt)||!Number.isFinite(value.expiresAt)||value.expiresAt<=now()||value.expiresAt>now()+TTL){forget();return null;}return value.receipt;}catch{return null;}}
  function save(receipt){if(!valid(receipt)||!storage)return false;try{storage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify({receipt,expiresAt:now()+TTL}));return load()===receipt;}catch{return false;}}
  return {load,save,forget};
 }
 const api={createStore};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCommunityReceiptStore=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 const escape=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
 function sourceLink(value){try{const u=new URL(value);if(u.protocol!=='https:'||u.username||u.password)return '';return `<a href="${escape(u.href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${escape(u.hostname)}</a>`;}catch{return '';}}
 const messages={received:'waiting',answered:'answered',withdrawn:'withdrawn',expired:'expired',not_found:'notFound',closed:'closed',unavailable:'unavailable',offline:'offline',rate_limited:'rateLimited',conflict:'unavailable',retry:'unavailable'};
 function receiptChoices(s){
  const c=root.LiftWorkflowCopy?.[s.locale==='my'?'my':'en'];if(!c)return '';
  if(s.testOnly)return `<p class="intake-notice">${escape(c.testReceiptLimit)}</p>`;
  if(!s.receipt&&!s.remembered)return '';
  return `<section class="intake-receipt-saving"><p>${escape(c.receiptSaveHelp)}</p>${s.receipt?`<button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="remember" ${s.busy?'disabled':''}>${escape(c.saveReceipt)}</button>`:''}${s.remembered?`<button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="forget" ${s.busy?'disabled':''}>${escape(c.forgetReceipt)}</button>`:''}</section>`;
 }
 function render(copy,s){
  const t=k=>escape(copy[k]),disabled=s.busy?'disabled':'',receiptAllowed=s.receiptsEnabled??s.enabled,receiptDisabled=s.busy||!receiptAllowed?'disabled':'';
  if(s.mode==='consent')return `<h2>${t('send')}</h2><p>${t('notice')}</p>${!s.enabled?`<p class="intake-notice" role="note">${t('closed')}</p>`:''}<form method="dialog" data-intake-form><div class="intake-consents">${['adult','consent','ai'].map(k=>`<label class="intake-choice"><input type="checkbox" data-intake-consent="${k}" ${s.consents[k]?'checked':''} ${disabled}><span>${t(k)}</span></label>`).join('')}</div><p>${t('aiHelp')}</p><details><summary>${t('retention')}</summary><p>${t('receiptWarning')}</p></details><p>${t('noUrgent')}</p><button type="button" data-intake-action="send" ${!s.enabled||s.busy||!s.consents.adult||!s.consents.consent?'disabled':''}>${t('confirmSend')}</button><button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="lookup" ${disabled}>${t('check')}</button></form>`;
  if(s.mode==='lookup')return `<h2>${t('check')}</h2><p>${t('receiptWarning')}</p><label for="intake-code">${t('enterReceipt')}</label><input id="intake-code" type="text" value="${escape(s.lookup)}" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" maxlength="43" data-intake-code data-user-content ${disabled}><button type="button" data-intake-action="check" ${receiptDisabled}>${t('checkAction')}</button>${!receiptAllowed?`<p>${t('closed')}</p>`:''}${receiptChoices(s)}`;
  const code=`<label for="intake-receipt" class="${s.mode==='receipt'?'intake-sr-only':''}">${t('receipt')}</label><textarea id="intake-receipt" readonly rows="2" data-user-content autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">${escape(s.receipt)}</textarea><p class="intake-notice">${t('receiptWarning')}</p><p>${t('receiptMemory')}</p><div class="intake-actions"><button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="copy">${t('copyReceipt')}</button><button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="download">${t('saveReceipt')}</button></div>${receiptChoices(s)}`;
  if(s.mode==='confirm-withdraw')return `<h2>${t('withdraw')}</h2>${code}<p>${t('withdrawExplain')}</p><button type="button" data-intake-action="confirm-withdraw" ${receiptDisabled}>${t('confirmWithdraw')}</button><button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="check" ${receiptDisabled}>${t('checkAction')}</button>`;
  const reply=s.view?.status==='answered'?`<section class="intake-reply"><h3>${t('reply')}</h3><p data-user-content>${escape(s.view.reply[s.locale]||s.view.reply.en)}</p>${s.view.reply.sources.map(sourceLink).join(' ')}</section>`:'';
  return `<h2>${t('receipt')}</h2>${code}<p role="status">${s.busy?t('sending'):t(s.justSent&&s.view?.status==='received'?'received':messages[s.view?.status]||'unavailable')}</p>${reply}<button type="button" data-intake-action="check" ${receiptDisabled}>${t('checkAction')}</button>${!['withdrawn','expired','not_found'].includes(s.view?.status)?`<button type="button" class="intake-secondary" data-intake-action="withdraw" ${receiptDisabled}>${t('withdraw')}</button>`:''}`;
 }
 function mount(element,{copy,locale='en',enabled=false,receiptsEnabled=enabled,initialMode='consent',draft,receiptStore,clientFactory=()=>root.LiftCommunityIntakeClient.createClient()}={}){
  let storage;try{storage=root.localStorage;}catch{}
  const savedReceipts=receiptStore||root.LiftCommunityReceiptStore?.createStore({storage}),remembered=root.LIFT_TEAM_TEST?null:savedReceipts?.load();
  const client=clientFactory(),s={mode:initialMode==='lookup'?'lookup':'consent',locale,enabled,receiptsEnabled,consents:{adult:false,consent:false,ai:false},lookup:remembered||'',receipt:'',remembered:remembered||'',testOnly:root.LIFT_TEAM_TEST===true,view:null,busy:false,justSent:false};
  element.classList.add('community-intake-root');element.lang=locale;
  let destroyed=false;
  function paint(){if(destroyed)return;element.innerHTML=render(copy,s)+'<p data-intake-feedback role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>';}
  function feedback(key){if(destroyed)return;const node=element.querySelector('[data-intake-feedback]');if(node)node.textContent=copy[key];}
  async function call(operation){s.busy=true;paint();try{s.view=await operation();}catch{s.view={status:'unavailable'};}finally{s.busy=false;s.mode='receipt';paint();}}
  async function click(event){const control=event.target.closest('[data-intake-action]');if(!control)return;event.preventDefault();const action=control.dataset.intakeAction;
   if(action==='remember'){if(s.testOnly||s.busy)return;const saved=savedReceipts?.save(s.receipt)===true;if(saved)s.remembered=s.receipt;paint();const c=root.LiftWorkflowCopy?.[s.locale==='my'?'my':'en'];const node=element.querySelector('[data-intake-feedback]');if(node&&c)node.textContent=c[saved?'receiptSaved':'receiptNotSaved'];return;}
   if(action==='forget'){if(s.testOnly||s.busy)return;if(savedReceipts?.forget()===true){s.remembered='';s.lookup='';}paint();return;}
   if(action==='copy'){try{await root.navigator.clipboard.writeText(s.receipt);}catch{feedback('saveReceipt');}return;}
   if(action==='download'){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([copy.receipt+'\n\n'+s.receipt+'\n\n'+copy.receiptWarning],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'})),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='lift-private-receipt.txt';document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);return;}
   if(s.busy)return;
   if(action==='lookup'){s.mode='lookup';paint();element.querySelector('[data-intake-code]')?.focus();return;}
   if((action==='send'&&!s.enabled)||(['check','withdraw','confirm-withdraw'].includes(action)&&!s.receiptsEnabled)){feedback('closed');return;}
   if(action==='send'){
    if(!s.consents.adult||!s.consents.consent){feedback('consentNeeded');return;}
    try{s.receipt=client.begin(typeof draft==='function'?draft():draft,{adult:s.consents.adult,review:s.consents.consent,ai:s.consents.ai});}catch{feedback('unavailable');return;}
    s.mode='receipt';s.justSent=true;await call(()=>client.send());return;
   }
   if(action==='check'){
    const receipt=s.mode==='lookup'?s.lookup:s.receipt;if(!root.LiftCommunityIntakeClient.validReceipt(receipt)){feedback('invalidReceipt');return;}s.receipt=receipt;s.justSent=false;await call(()=>client.check(receipt));return;
   }
   if(action==='withdraw'){s.mode='confirm-withdraw';paint();return;}
   if(action==='confirm-withdraw'){s.justSent=false;await call(()=>client.withdraw(s.receipt));}
  }
  function change(event){const key=event.target.dataset.intakeConsent;if(key){s.consents[key]=event.target.checked;const button=element.querySelector('[data-intake-action="send"]');if(button)button.disabled=!s.enabled||!s.consents.adult||!s.consents.consent;}}
  function input(event){if(event.target.matches('[data-intake-code]'))s.lookup=event.target.value.trim();}
  function submit(event){event.preventDefault();}
  element.addEventListener('click',click);element.addEventListener('change',change);element.addEventListener('input',input);element.addEventListener('submit',submit);paint();
  return {showLookup(){if(s.busy)return;s.mode='lookup';s.lookup=s.receipt||s.remembered||s.lookup;paint();},showConsent(){if(s.busy)return;s.mode=s.receipt?'receipt':'consent';paint();},setLanguage(nextCopy,nextLocale){copy=nextCopy;s.locale=nextLocale;element.lang=nextLocale;paint();},setAvailability({enabled=false,receiptsEnabled=false}={}){s.enabled=enabled===true;s.receiptsEnabled=receiptsEnabled===true;paint();},destroy(){destroyed=true;element.removeEventListener('click',click);element.removeEventListener('change',change);element.removeEventListener('input',input);element.removeEventListener('submit',submit);element.replaceChildren();}};
 }
 const api={render,mount};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCommunityIntakeUI=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 // Reparent one live panel after route rendering. Never serialise its state.
 function createSession({mountUI=(element,options)=>root.LiftCommunityIntakeUI.mount(element,options),makeElement=()=>root.document.createElement('section')}={}){
  let element,panel,lastCopy,lastLocale;
  return {
   attach(slot,options){
    if(!slot||typeof slot.append!=='function')throw Error('Intake route slot required');
    if(!panel){element=makeElement();panel=mountUI(element,options);lastCopy=options.copy;lastLocale=options.locale;}
    else{
     if(lastCopy!==options.copy||lastLocale!==options.locale){panel.setLanguage(options.copy,options.locale);lastCopy=options.copy;lastLocale=options.locale;}
     panel.setAvailability({enabled:options.enabled===true,receiptsEnabled:options.receiptsEnabled===true});
    }
    slot.append(element);
   },
   showConsent(){panel?.showConsent();},
   showLookup(){panel?.showLookup();},
   exists(){return Boolean(panel);},
   destroy(){panel?.destroy();element?.remove();element=panel=lastCopy=lastLocale=undefined;}
  };
 }
 const api={createSession};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCommunityIntakeSession=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 function createAvailability({fetchImpl=root.fetch?.bind(root),timeoutMs=5000}={}){
  let value={submissionsOpen:false,receiptsOpen:false},active=null;
  return {current:()=>({...value}),refresh(){
   if(active)return active;
   const controller=typeof root.AbortController==='function'?new root.AbortController():null;let timer;
   const deadline=new Promise(resolve=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>{resolve(null);controller?.abort();},timeoutMs);});
   const read=async()=>{try{const r=await fetchImpl('/api/community-availability',{method:'GET',credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',redirect:'error',signal:controller?.signal});if(r.status!==200)return null;const body=await r.json();return typeof body?.submissionsOpen==='boolean'&&typeof body?.receiptsOpen==='boolean'&&(!body.submissionsOpen||body.receiptsOpen)?{submissionsOpen:body.submissionsOpen,receiptsOpen:body.receiptsOpen}:null;}catch{return null;}};
   active=Promise.race([read(),deadline]).then(next=>{value=next||{...value,submissionsOpen:false};return {...value};}).finally(()=>{clearTimeout(timer);active=null;});return active;
  }};
 }
 const api={createAvailability};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCommunityIntakeAvailability=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>

(function(){

<script>(function(root){'use strict';
function project({cash,days,daily,bills=[],income=0,incomeDay=null,delay=0,reduction=0}){
 for(const n of [cash,daily,income,reduction])if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<0)throw Error('amount');
 if(!Number.isInteger(days)||days<1||days>31||!Number.isInteger(delay)||delay<0||delay>31)throw Error('days');
 if(incomeDay!==null&&(!Number.isInteger(incomeDay)||incomeDay<1||incomeDay>31))throw Error('incomeDay');
 for(const bill of bills)if(!Number.isInteger(bill.day)||bill.day<1||bill.day>days||!Number.isSafeInteger(bill.amount)||bill.amount<0)throw Error('bill');
 let balance=cash,firstGap=null,lowest=cash;const timeline=[];
 for(let day=1;day<=days;day++){const due=bills.filter(b=>b.day===day).reduce((sum,b)=>sum+b.amount,0);const out=Math.max(0,daily-reduction)+due;
 // Conservatively show bills and daily costs before same-day expected income.
 const beforeIncome=balance-out;if(beforeIncome<0&&firstGap===null)firstGap=day;lowest=Math.min(lowest,beforeIncome);
 const incoming=incomeDay!==null&&day===incomeDay+delay?income:0;balance=beforeIncome+incoming;
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(balance)||!Number.isSafeInteger(out))throw Error('amount');timeline.push({day,out,incoming,balance,beforeIncome});}
 return {timeline,firstGap,lowest,closing:balance,gap:Math.max(0,-lowest)};
}
const api={project};if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.LiftCashflow=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>(function(root){'use strict';
const routes=['daily','dates','family','community','resources','language','steps','spending'];
const actions={daily:'daily',dates:'dates',family:'family',community:'community',resources:'resources',language:'language',steps:'steps',spending:'spending'};
const sourceIds={daily:'cfpb',dates:'lift',family:'lift',community:'unesco',resources:'unesco',language:'lift',steps:'lift',spending:'cfpb'};
const sources={cfpb:{url:'https://www.consumerfinance.gov/consumer-tools/educator-tools/your-money-your-goals/toolkit/',label:'CFPB · English',scope:'General money education; not Thai financial advice',checked:'2026-10-15'},unesco:{url:'https://www.unesco.org/en/media-information-literacy/five-laws',label:'UNESCO · English',scope:'Information literacy principles; not individual service verification',checked:'2026-10-15'},lift:{url:null,label:'Lift',scope:'How this prototype works; not confirmation of an external outcome',checked:'2026-10-15'}};
function lesson(route){if(!routes.includes(route))return null;return {id:'lift-'+route+'-v1',version:1,route,action:actions[route],source:sourceIds[route],correct:'yes',options:routes.indexOf(route)%2?['no','yes']:['yes','no'],kind:'educational-example',qualifiedAdvice:false};}
function answer(route,value){return !!lesson(route)&&value==='yes';}
const api={routes,lesson,answer,sources};if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.LiftLearning=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);

နှိုင်းယှဉ်ပါ။","steps_question":"ရည်မှန်းချက်တစ်ခုကို ပြောင်းထားပါသည်။ ၎င်းက မည်သည့်အရာကို အတည်ပြုပါသလဲ။","steps_yes":"အစီအစဉ်ပြောင်းသွားကြောင်းသာ အတည်ပြုပါသည်။ လုပ်ဆောင်ရန် ကျန်ပါသေးသည်","steps_no":"ရည်မှန်းချက် ပြည့်မီပြီးကြောင်း","steps_next":"ယခင်ရည်မှန်းချက်ကို ပြန်ကြည့်ပြီး လုပ်နိုင်သည့် လုပ်ဆောင်ချက်တစ်ခုကို ရွေးပါ။ ရည်မှန်းချက်ကို ဆက်ထားမည် သို့မဟုတ် ပြောင်းမည်ကို စဉ်းစားရွေးချယ်ပါ။","spending_title":"အချိန်ကွာလျှင် ရလဒ်ပြောင်းနိုင်ပါသည်","spending_meaning":"တစ်လလုံးအတွက် ဝင်ငွေလုံလောက်ခြင်းသည် ငွေပေးချေရမည့်ရက်တွင် လက်ထဲငွေလုံလောက်မည်ဟု အမြဲမဆိုလိုပါ။ အာမခံပါသည်","spending_next":"လာမည့်ရက်များဆိုင်ရာ နမူနာကို စမ်းပြီး ဝင်ငွေနောက်ကျလျှင် မည်သို့ဖြစ်မည်ကို နှိုင်းယှဉ်ပါ။"}};
</script>
<script>'use strict';
let cashflowDraft={values:{days:'7'},result:null,error:false};
function cashText(key){return learningText('cash_'+key);}
function cashNumber(value){return new Intl.NumberFormat(LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my-MM':'en',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(value);}
function cashAmount(value){return new Intl.NumberFormat(LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my-MM':'en',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(value/100)+' THB';}
function cashInput(key){return `<label for="cash-${key}">${escapeText(cashText(key))}</label><input id="cash-${key}" name="${key}" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" maxlength="16" value="${escapeText(cashflowDraft.values[key]||'')}" ${['cash','daily'].includes(key)?'required':''}>`;}
function cashDaySelect(key,horizon=false){const values=horizon?[7,14,30]:Array.from({length:31},(_,i)=>i+1);return `<label for="cash-${key}">${escapeText(cashText(key))}</label><select id="cash-${key}" name="${key}">${horizon?'':`<option value="">${escapeText(cashText('unknown'))}</option>`}${values.map(day=>`<option value="${day}" ${String(day)===cashflowDraft.values[key]?'selected':''}>${cashNumber(day)}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;}
function cashSummary(result,title){return `<section class="cash-summary ${result.firstGap?'cash-gap':''}"><h3>${icon('money')}${escapeText(title)}</h3><dl><div><dt>${escapeText(cashText('first'))}</dt><dd>${result.firstGap?escapeText(cashText('day'))+' '+cashNumber(result.firstGap):escapeText(cashText('none'))}</dd></div><div><dt>${escapeText(cashText('gap'))}</dt><dd>${cashAmount(result.gap)}</dd></div><div><dt>${escapeText(cashText('closing'))}</dt><dd>${cashAmount(result.closing)}</dd></div></dl></section>`;}
function cashResults(){const r=cashflowDraft.result;if(!r)return '';return `<div data-user-content>${cashSummary(r.base,cashText('original'))}${r.late?cashSummary(r.late,cashText('scenario')):''}${r.changed?cashSummary(r.changed,cashText('changed')):''}<details class="cash-timeline"><summary>${escapeText(cashText('timeline'))}</summary><div class="cash-days">${r.base.timeline.map(row=>`<article><h4>${escapeText(cashText('day'))} ${cashNumber(row.day)}</h4><dl><div><dt>${escapeText(cashText('out'))}</dt><dd>${cashAmount(row.out)}</dd></div><div><dt>${escapeText(cashText('incoming'))}</dt><dd>${cashAmount(row.incoming)}</dd></div><div><dt>${escapeText(cashText('balance'))}</dt><dd>${cashAmount(row.balance)}</dd></div></dl></article>`).join('')}</div></details><details class="cash-explanation"><summary>${escapeText(cashText('learn'))}</summary><p>${escapeText(cashText('lesson'))}</p><p>${escapeText(cashText('limits'))}</p></details><details class="cash-explanation"><summary>${escapeText(cashText('action'))}</summary><p>${escapeText(cashText('actionHelp'))}</p></details></div>${spendingConnections()}`;}
function cashflowPanel(){return `<details class="content-card cashflow-tool" data-user-content><summary>${icon('money')}<span>${escapeText(cashText('title'))}</span>${icon('arrow')}</summary><div class="learning-body"><p>${escapeText(cashText('intro'))}</p><button type="button" class="secondary" data-cash-example>${escapeText(cashText('example'))}</button><form id="cashflow-form" novalidate>${cashDaySelect('days',true)}${cashInput('cash')}${cashInput('daily')}<details class="cash-optional"><summary>${escapeText(cashText('bill'))} · ${escapeText(cashText('incoming'))}</summary>${cashInput('bill')}${cashDaySelect('billDay')}${cashInput('income')}${cashDaySelect('incomeDay')}<p>${escapeText(cashText('expected'))}</p></details><details class="cash-optional"><summary>${escapeText(cashText('compare'))}</summary>${cashInput('reduction')}<p>${escapeText(cashText('reductionHelp'))}</p></details><p id="cash-error" role="alert">${cashflowDraft.error?escapeText(cashText('error')):''}</p><div class="plan-actions"><button type="submit" class="primary">${escapeText(cashText('calculate'))}</button><button type="button" class="secondary" data-cash-clear>${escapeText(cashText('reset'))}</button></div></form><section id="cash-results" tabindex="-1" aria-live="polite">${cashResults()}</section><p class="dialog-note">${escapeText(cashText('limits'))}</p><a href="https://www.consumerfinance.gov/consumer-tools/educator-tools/your-money-your-goals/toolkit/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${escapeText(cashText('source'))}</a></div></details>`;}
function cashflowParse(values){const cash=LiftSpending.parse(values.cash||''),daily=LiftSpending.parse(values.daily||'');if(cash===null||daily===null)throw Error('required');const days=Number(values.days),bill=LiftSpending.parse(values.bill||'')||0,income=LiftSpending.parse(values.income||'')||0,reduction=LiftSpending.parse(values.reduction||'')||0,billDay=values.billDay?Number(values.billDay):null,incomeDay=values.incomeDay?Number(values.incomeDay):null;if(reduction>daily||(bill>0&&(!billDay||billDay>days))||(income>0&&!incomeDay))throw Error('date');return {cash,daily,days,bills:bill?[{day:billDay,amount:bill}]:[],income,incomeDay,reduction};}
function cashflowCalculate(values){const parsed=cashflowParse(values),{reduction,...original}=parsed;const base=LiftCashflow.project(original),late=original.income>0?LiftCashflow.project({...original,delay:3}):null,changed=reduction>0?LiftCashflow.project({...original,reduction}):null;return {base,late,changed};}
const cashflowBaseSpending=spendingPage;
spendingPage=function(){return cashflowBaseSpending()+cashflowPanel();};
function cashflowReset(){cashflowDraft={values:{days:'7'},result:null,error:false};}
document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(!event.target.closest('#cashflow-form'))return;cashflowDraft.values[event.target.name]=event.target.value;cashflowDraft.result=null;cashflowDraft.error=false;document.getElementById('cash-results').replaceChildren();document.getElementById('cash-error').textContent='';});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(!event.target.closest('#cashflow-form'))return;cashflowDraft.values[event.target.name]=event.target.value;cashflowDraft.result=null;cashflowDraft.error=false;document.getElementById('cash-results').replaceChildren();document.getElementById('cash-error').textContent='';});
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{if(event.target.id!=='cashflow-form')return;event.preventDefault();try{cashflowDraft.result=cashflowCalculate(cashflowDraft.values);cashflowDraft.error=false;document.getElementById('cash-error').textContent='';const out=document.getElementById('cash-results');out.innerHTML=cashResults();out.focus();out.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});}catch{cashflowDraft.result=null;cashflowDraft.error=true;document.getElementById('cash-results').replaceChildren();document.getElementById('cash-error').textContent=cashText('error');document.getElementById('cash-error').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});}});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target.closest('[data-cash-open]')){const panel=document.querySelector('.cashflow-tool');if(panel){panel.open=true;panel.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});panel.querySelector('summary').focus();}return;}if(event.target.closest('[data-action="confirm-clear"]'))cashflowReset();const clear=event.target.closest('[data-cash-clear]'),example=event.target.closest('[data-cash-example]');if(!clear&&!example)return;cashflowReset();if(example){cashflowDraft.values={days:'7',cash:'100',daily:'20',income:'200',incomeDay:'7'};cashflowDraft.result=cashflowCalculate(cashflowDraft.values);}const old=document.querySelector('.cashflow-tool'),holder=document.createElement('div');holder.innerHTML=cashflowPanel();const next=holder.firstElementChild;next.open=true;old.replaceWith(next);const target=next.querySelector(example?'#cash-results':'#cash-cash');target.focus();if(example)target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});});
</script>
<script>window.LiftCashTransferCopy={"en":{"title":"Review before using this amount","explain":"This is the remainder of your spending calculation, not a confirmed current cash balance. Some costs may still be unpaid. <script>'use strict';
(function(root){
 const MAX=999999999;
 function offer(result,period){if(!['today','week','month'].includes(period)||!result)return null;const {available,costs,remaining}=result;if(![available,costs,remaining].every(Number.isSafeInteger)||available<0||costs<0||remaining<0||remaining>MAX||available-costs!==remaining)return null;return {amount:remaining,period,key:[period,available,costs,remaining].join(':')};}
 function accept(proposal,current,{confirmed=false,key}={}){if(!proposal||confirmed!==true||proposal.key!==key||!current||String(current.cash??'')!=='')return null;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(proposal.amount)||proposal.amount<0||proposal.amount>MAX)return null;return {...current,cash:(proposal.amount/100).toFixed(2)};}
 const api={offer,accept};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.LiftCashflowTransfer=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);
</script>
<script>'use strict';
(function(){
 let pending=null;
 const t=key=>window.LiftCashTransferCopy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'][key];
 function clear(){pending=null;document.getElementById('cash-transfer-offer')?.remove();document.getElementById('cash-transfer-status')?.remove();}
 function show(){clear();if(String(cashflowDraft.values.cash??'')!=='')return;const proposal=LiftCashflowTransfer.offer(spendingDraft.result,spendingDraft.period),form=document.getElementById('cashflow-form');if(!proposal||!form)return;pending=proposal;const card=document.createElement('section');card.id='cash-transfer-offer';card.className='cash-transfer-offer';card.dataset.userContent='';card.innerHTML=`<h3>${escapeText(t('title'))}</h3><p>${escapeText(t('explain'))}</p><p>${escapeText(spendingLabel('result'))} · ${escapeText(spendingLabel(proposal.period))}: <strong>${cashAmount(proposal.amount)}</strong></p><label for="cash-transfer-confirm"><input type="checkbox" id="cash-transfer-confirm">${escapeText(t('confirm'))}</label><div class="plan-actions"><button type="button" class="secondary" data-cash-transfer-use disabled>${escapeText(t('use'))}</button><button type="button" class="text-button" data-cash-transfer-own>${escapeText(t('own'))}</button></div>`;form.before(card);card.querySelector('h3').setAttribute('tabindex','-1');card.querySelector('h3').focus();}
 window.addEventListener('hashchange',clear);
 document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(event.target.matches('[data-spending-input],#cash-cash'))clear();});
 document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.target.id==='spending-period')clear();if(event.target.id==='cash-transfer-confirm'){const button=document.querySelector('[data-cash-transfer-use]');if(button)button.disabled=!event.target.checked;}});
 document.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target.closest('[data-cash-open]')){show();return;}if(event.target.closest('[data-locale],[data-cash-clear],[data-cash-example],[data-action="spending-clear"],[data-action="confirm-clear"]')){clear();return;}if(event.target.closest('[data-cash-transfer-own]')){clear();document.getElementById('cash-cash')?.focus();return;}if(!event.target.closest('[data-cash-transfer-use]'))return;const proposal=LiftCashflowTransfer.offer(spendingDraft.result,spendingDraft.period),confirmed=document.getElementById('cash-transfer-confirm')?.checked===true,next=LiftCashflowTransfer.accept(proposal,cashflowDraft.values,{confirmed,key:pending?.key});if(!next)return;cashflowDraft.values=next;cashflowDraft.result=null;cashflowDraft.error=false;const input=document.getElementById('cash-cash');if(input)input.value=next.cash;document.getElementById('cash-results')?.replaceChildren();const status=document.getElementById('cash-error');if(status)status.textContent='';clear();const note=document.createElement('p');note.id='cash-transfer-status';note.className='dialog-note';note.setAttribute('role','status');note.textContent=t('applied');document.getElementById('cashflow-form')?.before(note);document.getElementById('cash-daily')?.focus();});
})();
</script>
<script>'use strict';
// Practice state never enters the personal planner, storage, exports or network.
let liftPractice=Object.create(null);
function learningText(key){const copy=window.LiftLearningCopy;return copy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'][key];}
function learningCard(route){const lesson=LiftLearning.lesson(route);if(!lesson)return '';const t=learningText,p=liftPractice[route]||{},source=LiftLearning.sources[lesson.source];return `<details class="content-card lift-learning" data-learning-route="${route}" data-user-content><summary>${icon('learn')}<span>${escapeText(t('shared_learn'))}<strong>${escapeText(t(route+'_title'))}</strong></span>${icon('arrow')}</summary><div class="learning-body"><p>${escapeText(t(route+'_meaning'))}</p><form data-learning-form="${route}"><fieldset><legend>${escapeText(t('shared_practice'))}</legend><p>${escapeText(t(route+'_question'))}</p><label for="practice-${route}">${escapeText(t('shared_choose'))}</label><select id="practice-${route}" name="answer" required><option value="">${escapeText(t('shared_choose'))}</option>${lesson.options.map(value=>`<option value="${value}" ${p.answer===value?'selected':''}>${escapeText(t(route+'_'+value))}</option>`).join('')}</select><p class="learning-selected-answer" data-learning-selected>${p.answer?escapeText(t(route+'_'+p.answer)):''}</p><button type="submit" class="secondary">${escapeText(t('shared_check'))}</button></fieldset><div class="learning-feedback" role="status">${p.checked?`<p>${escapeText(t(LiftLearning.answer(route,p.answer)?'shared_correct':'shared_retry'))}</p><p>${escapeText(t(route+'_meaning'))}</p>`:''}</div></form><h3>${escapeText(t('shared_action'))}</h3><p>${escapeText(t(route+'_next'))}</p><label class="learning-tried"><input type="checkbox" data-learning-tried="${route}" ${p.tried?'checked':''}>${escapeText(t('shared_done'))}</label><p class="dialog-note">${escapeText(t('shared_doneNote'))}</p><p class="dialog-note">${escapeText(t('shared_privacy'))}</p><p class="dialog-note">${escapeText(t('shared_skip'))}</p><button type="button" class="text-button" data-learning-reset="${route}">${escapeText(t('shared_reset'))}</button><p class="learning-source">${source.url?`<a href="${source.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${escapeText(source.label)}</a>`:escapeText(source.label)}</p></div></details>`;}
function mountLearning(){const route=document.body.dataset.route;if(!LiftLearning.lesson(route)||document.querySelector('[data-learning-route]'))return;const holder=document.createElement('div');holder.innerHTML=learningCard(route);const card=holder.firstElementChild;document.querySelector('main')?.append(card);}
const learningBaseRoute=route;
route=function(){learningBaseRoute();mountLearning();};
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{const form=event.target.closest('[data-learning-form]');if(!form)return;event.preventDefault();const r=form.dataset.learningForm;if(!LiftLearning.lesson(r))return;const value=form.querySelector('select').value;if(!['yes','no'].includes(value))return;liftPractice[r]={...liftPractice[r],answer:value,checked:true};const out=form.querySelector('.learning-feedback');out.replaceChildren();for(const text of [learningText(LiftLearning.answer(r,value)?'shared_correct':'shared_retry'),learningText(r+'_meaning')]){const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=text;out.append(p);}});
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{const tried=event.target.dataset.learningTried;if(LiftLearning.lesson(tried))liftPractice[tried]={...liftPractice[tried],tried:event.target.checked};const form=event.target.closest('[data-learning-form]');if(form&&event.target.matches('select')){const r=form.dataset.learningForm;liftPractice[r]={...liftPractice[r],answer:event.target.value,checked:false};form.querySelector('.learning-feedback').replaceChildren();form.querySelector('[data-learning-selected]').textContent=event.target.value?learningText(r+'_'+event.target.value):'';}});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const reset=event.target.closest('[data-learning-reset]');if(reset){const r=reset.dataset.learningReset;delete liftPractice[r];const card=reset.closest('[data-learning-route]');const holder=document.createElement('div');holder.innerHTML=learningCard(r);const next=holder.firstElementChild;next.open=true;card.replaceWith(next);next.querySelector('summary').focus();}if(event.target.closest('[data-action="confirm-clear"]')){liftPractice=Object.create(null);route();}});
route();
</script>
<script>'use strict';
function workflowText(key){return window.LiftWorkflowCopy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'][key];}
// Canonical tools remain on their own routes; group pages contain links only.
function workflowLinks(items){return `<div class="companion-secondary">${items.map(([path,symbol,label])=>`<a href="#${path}">${icon(symbol)}<span>${escapeText(label)}</span>${icon('arrow')}</a>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function lifePage(){return heading('One thing at a time','Everyday life','')+workflowLinks([['daily','people',everydayLabel('title')],['spending','money',spendingLabel('title')],['dates','steps',dateLabel('open')],['language','globe',phaseOneTools.title],['prepare','people',LiftI18n.t('Prepare a conversation')],['resources','book',LiftI18n.t('Useful information')]]);}
function minePage(){return heading('One thing at a time',workflowText('navMine'),workflowText('mineIntro'))+workflowLinks([['steps','steps',LiftI18n.t('My next steps')],['receipts','lock',LiftCommunityIntakeCopy[LiftI18n.locale==='my'?'my':'en'].check],['privacy','shield',LiftI18n.t('My privacy')]]);}
function workflowNavigation(){for(const nav of document.querySelectorAll('.nav-list,.mobile-nav')){const mobile=nav.classList.contains('mobile-nav');nav.innerHTML=LiftWorkflow.navigation.map(item=>`<a href="#${item.route}" data-route="${item.route}" ${mobile?'':'class="nav-link"'}><span data-icon="${item.icon}"></span><span>${escapeText(workflowText(item.copy))}</span>${!mobile&&item.route==='mine'?'<span class="nav-count" id="nav-count">0</span>':''}</a>`).join('');}}
const workflowBaseRoute=route;
route=function(){workflowBaseRoute();workflowNavigation();document.getElementById('nav-count').textContent=state.plan?String(totalTasks()-progress()):'0';paintIcons();const group=LiftWorkflow.group(document.body.dataset.route);for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]')){const active=el.dataset.route===group;el.classList.toggle('active',active);if(active)el.setAttribute('aria-current','page');else el.removeAttribute('aria-current');}};
workflowNavigation();route();
// Reserve the actual wrapped navigation height, including enlarged Myanmar text.
function reserveWorkflowNavigation(){const nav=document.querySelector('.mobile-nav');if(nav)document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--workflow-nav-space',Math.ceil(nav.getBoundingClientRect().height+24)+'px');}
if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined'){const workflowNavObserver=new ResizeObserver(reserveWorkflowNavigation);const workflowNav=document.querySelector('.mobile-nav');if(workflowNav)workflowNavObserver.observe(workflowNav);}
reserveWorkflowNavigation();
</script>
